'dir mi 'byung yang gzhan ltar na ye shes dbab pa'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba kha bskang yang mi rung ba med par sems so// de ltar na 'og gi gsol gdab 'di yang yar blangs te gzod slob ma lhar bskyed na bde bar mngon no// du slob ma rnams yi ge drug pa dang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su khyed rnams hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje shugs sku mdog sngon po nas mgo bo dang thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba'i skur gyur par mos nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ de bzhin gshegs pa nas gyur cig ces gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rnams kyi lte bar laṃ las zhes pa nas oṃ dkar po rnams gsal btab nas/ slob dpon la rdo rje sems dpa' dus kyi 'khor lo dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ khyed rnams lus la bkod pa'i yi ge de rnams dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad rdo rje bzhi'i rnam pa dpag tu med par spyan drangs nas khyed rnams kyi yi ge bzhi la gnyis su med par thim par mos/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum raṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du yi ge dzhaiṃḥdamar po rnams gsal btab/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ khyed rnams kyi rkang 'og gi rlung la phog pas rlung g.yos te me sbar/ dzhaiṃḥ'abar ba las 'od zer 'phros pas khyed rnams gyen du 'degs shing*/ 'od zer gyi tshogs rkang pa'i bu ga nas zhugs pas yi ge bzhi drag tu bskyod de/ 'od zer 'phros pas lus kun tu khyab cing gang bar gyur par mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i spos kyis bdug cing dril bu dkrol te/

oṃ a ra ra sogs nas hūm̐ zhes pas khro bo'i gtso bo bskul nas khro bo dpag tu med pa de'i lus la zhugs par bsam zhing ye shes dbab bo// de'ang khro bo phebs na mtshon chas bdud la bsdigs pa dang*/ rkang lag gis gar byed/ ngag gis rdo rje'i glu len cing*/ spyir sku phebs na nam mkhar 'gro ba sogs sku'i bya ba/ gsung phebs na srid pa gsum las rgyal ba'i smra ba po/ thugs phebs na gzhan gyi sems dang dus gsum gyi lkog gyur shes par 'gyur la/ ye shes phebs na mngon shes lnga dang sa bcu'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ro// lha gzhan phebs pa'i mtshan ma sogs rgyas pa ni rgyud 'grel las shes par bya'o// de ltar ye shes phebs pa'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan par bya ba'am bsrung bar bya ba ni/ slob dpon gyis 'bru gsum gyis bsngags pa'i me tog khyed rnams kyi mgo bor bzhag ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod cing slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ/ snying gar hūm̐/ gtsug tor du haṃ ste thabs kyi rigs gsum dang*/ lte bar ho/ mgrin par āḥ gsang bar k+ṣaḥste shes rab kyi rigs gsum ste drug gis mtshan par gsal btab pas bsrungs par mos la lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor la'ang gzigs pa re mdzod cig de nas snang ba dri zhing dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa ni/ khyed rnams mig mig ras dang bcas te dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs la gzigs pa re byas pas/ rang rang gi mig lam na kha dog dkar ser la sogs pa gang snang ba zhig nged la smra dgos pas/ kye khyed kyi mig lam na ci snang zhes dri/ de'ang kha dog dkar po mthong na zhi ba/ ser po rgyas pa/ dmar po dbang*/ sngon po'am nag po mthong na mngon spyod/ ljang gu'am sna tshogs sam khra bo las sna tshogs pa 'grub par bstan no// de nas khyed rnams kyi lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis nas las kyi rdo rje'i phyag g.yas pa rdo rje dang bcas pas bzung nas rdo rje'i gar bya zhing sngags bzlas bzhin par dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gsum du byas par mos la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

rtsa ba'i sngags sam yi ge drug pa bzlar gzhug de ltar ye shes phebs pa de lhag pa'i lha dang ngo sprad pa'i slad du/ dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba 'debs kyin bden pa'i byin rlabs brjod pa slob dpon gyis bgyi dgos pas/ de'ang rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ yang dag dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma nas dkyil 'khor du gyur cig /ces lan gsum brjod do// de nas slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor dung chos kyi chus gtor zhing yi ge drug pas bsangs nas/ sngar gyi me tog phreng ba las ma rnyings pa'i me tog gcig phyung la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa lan bdun gyis bsngags te thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du byin la/ rgyal ba'i bum 'di rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la dgongs kyi/ ras bris la dkyil 'khor la dngos su me tog 'bul bcug kyang rung bar sems/ pa'i steng du mtshan ma lnga byas la/ dad mos sngon du 'gro bas dkyil 'khor la phul bar dmigs te/ der 'jug pa'i bsam pas rigs kyi lha rnam par sbyang ba'i don du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi rigs// rnam par spyod pa'i gzhi tshugs shig thā ga ta ku la bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog dor/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ di byin+d+ri yā ṇ+yut+gaha ṭa ya swā lha'i dbang po legs par phye ba'i gzhi tshugs/ hā/ zhes pas mig dar phye nas/ me tog gang du ltung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi rigs kyi lha// zhes brjod la/ me tog gang la phog pa de'i rigs kyi lha dang de'i las kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// me tog de slob dpon gyis blangs te/ oṃ pra ti gṛh+ṇa s+t+wa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog 'phog pa'i lha la bos nas/ lha des kyang me tog phreng ba slar byin par bsams la phreng ba mgo bor bcings/ slar yang he badz+ra pa sh+ya/ de'ang he zhes pa ni bod pa ste des khyed rnams la bos nas badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes pa ni rdo rje ltos shig ces pa ste kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ltos zhes bskul ba yin pas dkyil 'khor legs par gzigs shig ces bsgo/

slar yang dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul ba ni/ da ni dad pa'i shugs kyis su nas sgrub par gyis zhes go bar byas nas/ gang la blta ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ 'di na bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhugs te/ de la rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams sngar mdun bskyed kyi dus nas bskyed zin pa la/ 'dir de'i lha ngo bstan pa tsam yin pas/ dang po'i skyed byed kyi sa bon dang phyag mtshan rnams nges par dor dgos kyi/ nag 'gros su brjod du mi btub pas/ de'ang 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i rang bzhin gyi chos 'byung gi nang du/ ye shes kyi snang ba las grub pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams rlung me chu sa lhun po pad+ma zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan gyi steng du/ rdo rje'i gur gyi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor nor bu'i 'od zer rnam par 'phro ba can te/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi nas rim pa bzhin sogs 'dra zhing*/ sku'i rta babs kyi brtsegs ma 'og ma'i dbus su shar du chos 'khor nag po/ g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo/ lhor bum pa bzang po dmar po/ g.yas g.yon du dung dang pad+ma/ byang du rnga bo che dkar po/ g.yas g.yon du dbyug pa dang tho ba/ nub tu byang chub kyi shing ser po sogs 'dra zhing*/ rdo rje phreng ba nag pos bskor ba'i dbus su gtso bo'i pad+ma ljang gu 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte bar zla nyi sgra gcan gyi gdan/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i phyogs kyi le tshe bzhi dang*/ thugs kyi lha snam gyi sgo'i g.yas phyogs bzhi dang*/ shar dang lho'i sgo'i g.yon gnyis dang*/ lho dang nub kyi sgo'i dbus rnams su/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma'i gdan/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i mtshams bzhi dang*/ lha snam gyi mtshams bzhi dang*/ nub dang byang gi sgo'i g.yon gnyis dang*/ shar dang byang gi sgo'i dbus rnams su pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba'i gdan/

gsung gi lha snam gyi shar du yi dwags/ mer mkha' lding*/ lhor ma he/ bden bral du rma bya/ byang du khyu mchog dbang ldan du seng ge nub tu glang po che/ rlung du ngang pa'i gdan rnams kyi steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ phyogs su dmar po dang mtshams su dkar po re re/ sku'i lha snam la shar sgo'i g.yas su yi dwags/ mer ri dwags/ lho sgo'i g.yas su lug bden bral du rma bya/ byang sgo'i g.yas su chu srin/ dbang ldan du byi ba/ nub sgo'i g.yas su glang po che/ rlung du ngang pa/ byang sgo'i g.yon du khyu mchog nub sgo'i g.yon du glang po che/ shar sgo'i g.yon du mkha' lding*/ lho sgo'i g.yon du ma he'i gdan/ de rnams kyi steng du pad+ma 'dab ma dang po la bzhi/ bar pa la brgyad/ phyi ma la bcu drug ste 'dab ma nyer brgyad dang ldan pa phyogs su dmar po gnyis gnyis dang*/ mtshams su dkar po re re/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor phag nag po bdun/ lho sgor rta dmar po bdun/ byang sgor seng ge dkar po bdun/ nub sgor glang po ser po bdun/ steng du mkha' lding a ni la mdog lnga pa mig gsum pa lus rgyas pa bdun/ 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa bdun rnams kyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i gdan/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi kha khyer gyi steng rta babs kyi ka ba'i nang shar sgo'i g.yon g.yas su rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ lho sgo'i g.yon g.yas su me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ byang sgo'i g.yon g.yas su chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ nub sgo'i g.yon g.yas su sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ steng dang 'og tu nam mkha' dang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ljang gu dang sngon po zlum po/ phyi rol du mchod pa'i sa la pad+ma bum pa sogs mchod rdzas du mas gang ba/ gzhal yas khang gi sa gzhi dang steng thog thams cad kyi dbus sngon po/ shar nag lho dmar/ byang dkar/ nub ser ba/

phyi nas sa chu me rlung gi khor yug bzhis bskor ba'i sa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang ldan gyi mtshams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ bden bral gyi mtshams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro// me dang rlung gi dbus su dur khrod chen po brgyad kyis bskor ba'i shar rtse mos 'bigs pa'i dur khrod du bse/ mer lhag ma za ba'i dur khrod du bhe ruṇ+ḍa/ lhor ro bsregs pa'i dur khrod du mig sngon/ de rnams kyi steng du 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phyogs su dmar po dang*/ mtshams su dkar po re re/ steng du mkha' lding a ni la dang*/ 'og tu seng ge rkang pa brgyad pa rnams kyis drangs pa'i shing rta'i gdan/ nam mkha'i khor yug la rdo rje'i rwa ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol du 'od zer 'bar bas bskor ba dang bcas pa ni rten gzhal yas khang pa yin no// brten pa lha ngo bstan pa la dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gtso bo nas rim par bstan pa dang*/ 'khor nas nang du rim par bstan pa gnyis las/ 'dir 'grel chen las/ de nas rigs kyi lha dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang por byas pa'i dkyil 'khor mtha' dag bstan par bya'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar gtso bo dang por byas te bstan pa ni/ de'i dbus kyi zla nyi sgra gcan gyi steng du dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ sku mdog sngon po sogs nas rlung du dpag bsam gyi shing ser po zhes pa'i bar lha lhag gnas ltar brjod/ bde gshegs 'phar ma'i shar shar lho'i le tshe la don grub dang sgrol ma zhes sogs nas mkha' lding gdong ma las skyes pa'i sbrul 'ching bar 'dod ma dang*/ de'i phyir 'dod ma rnams kyang ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ zhes pa'i bar lha lhag gnas kyi skabs ji lta ba bzhin brjod/ de rnams ni brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams te/ mdor na lhag pa'i lha'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bur nges par mthong ngo snyam pas/

shin tu dga' ba'i blos slob dpon gyi zhabs la phyag byas par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor sogs nas hoḥhoḥhoḥzhes dam tshig brjod pa ste/ de rnams kyis lha dang skal ba mnyam pa'i ched du dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i cho ga rnams grub nas/ zhugs nas dbang bskur ba la byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun bskur ba dang*/ dbang gong ma bzhi bskur ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang dang gsum las/ dang po la dbang bdun gyi cho ga thob pa'i dus go ba/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ rtsa ltung spang bar gdams pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/ rdo rje snying 'grel las/ byis pa skyes pa ma yis ni// chu yis khrus byed dbang bskur ro// de yis gtsug phud rab bzhag pa// dbu rgyan du ni yongs su brtag /de yi rna ba 'bugs la sogs// dar dpyangs dbang du shes par bya// byis pa rgod dang smra ba nyid// rdo rje dril bu'i dbang nyid do// lnga pa longs spyod brtul zhugs so// ming ni ming gi dbang bskur ro// pha yis rtag tu klog la sogs// ster bar byed pa rjes gnang yin// rnam pa bdun po 'di nyid ni// dbang bdun du ni rab tu bshad// ces 'byung ba ltar las/ thog mar byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun zhu ba'i yon tan du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la sogs nas deng bdag gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ sngon 'gro byur bsal ba'i slad du sbyong ba rnams rim gyis bya dgos pa las/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas bye ba'i khro bo rdo rje shugs dang las kyi rdo rje tha dad med par gyur pa des sbyong ba rnams rim gyis bya dgos pa las/ thog mar slob dpon gyis yungs kar la oṃ nas k+ṣaḥzhes yi ge drug pa bzlas te/ khyed rnams kyi sku tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang dbang len pa la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad snying ga nas sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ nag po'i rnam pas sna sgor thon te mdun gyi yungs kar la thim pa de nyid me dang chur dor te sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/

yungs kar lag g.yas g.yon du bzung la/ g.yas pas g.yas dang g.yon pas g.yon dang gnyis kas g.yas su bskor te/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ nas da ha swā hā/ zhes lan gsum du bzlas shing dor/ de bzhin du chus kyang sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa kyis dor/ kham phor dkar po so ma btang bas kyang sbyangs/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ dūrba dang bcas pa'i chang bus kyang sbyangs/ oṃ sarba ma la a ba ra ṇa bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zan chang dang ting lo me 'bar bzhin pas kyang sbyangs/ oṃ puṇ+ya dzñā na dha rod saṃ bo dha ka ye swā hā/ sing ras dkar pos kyang sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ rdzas drug po 'di rnams rdo rje slob ma rnams kyi dbang po drug gi glud du khyer la sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor dril bu dkrol la yi ge drug pa brjod cing phyir dor ro// de nas nye reg bya ba'i don du khyed rnams tsog pur bsdad pa'i pus mo gnyis kyi bar du lag pa g.yon pa'i khyor mor chu bzung*/ g.yas pa'i gung srin gyis chu nas blangs te kha'i ze'u 'bru la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su nye reg byas pas 'bags pa dang ma dag pa'i dri ma rnams sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la gzigs te kha'i ze'u 'bru la lan gsum/ mig gnyis/ rna ba gnyis/ sna bug gnyis/ mchu gnyis/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ mgo bo'i steng*/ lto ba la byab pa'i tshul bya/ mthar kha bshal nas g.yon phyogs nas phyir pho ste/ lag pa g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyi rgyab kyis kha'i gsher rnams g.yas dang g.yon du phyi ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes mang du bzlas/ de ni khrus sam nye reg bya ba 'bags btsog sbyong ba yin/ mchod pas sbyang ba'i slad du thugs kar dri'i byug pa phul nas sbyangs par mos/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe hūm̐/ me tog dbu la phul bas sbyangs/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐/ mchod yon dung phor re mdun du phul bas sbyangs/ oṃ hrīḥpra bhā wasat+kā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ mar me sku lus la bskor te spyan lam du phul bas sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra dī pe hūm̐/ sardza ra dza'i bdug spos kyis bdugs te sbyangs par mos pa mdzod/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pa ni mchod pas sbyang ba dang bcas pa rnams ni dbang bskur ba'i sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga yin/ dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ lus ngag yid ye shes dag byed kyi dbang bzhi las/ re re la'ang gnas su dkri ba/ nang chog gis lhar bskyed pa/ dbang so sor bskur ba/ thun mong du dbang don bshad pa dang bzhi bzhi yod pa'i thog mar slob dpon gyis oṃ āḥnas k+ṣaḥzhes brjod kyin khyed rnams kyi lag pa g.yon pa nas bskyod pa dang*/ khyed rnams las kyi rdo rje dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs nas bskor ba byas nas byang sgor khrid par mos te 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥbyang phyogs sku rdo rje'i mdun du 'khod ces brjod/ de nas nang gi cho gas lhar bskyed pa'i don du slob dpon gyis oṃ nas k+ṣaḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams bsang*/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin byang phyogs sku rdo rje'i zhal nas zhugs/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes zhu/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas lha mo'i pad+mar 'phros pa'i byang chub kyi sems de/ skad cig gis sku rdo rje dkar po/ dkar nag dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas pa gsum na tho ba nas bgrang phreng 'dzin pa la gos dkar mo dmar mos 'khyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ nas/ lte bar hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhrī/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo'i tshogs rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

gan+dhaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ de rnams la slob dpon gyis/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba bskyab phyir dbang bskur ni// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas yab yum rnams snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba chen pos zhu ste/ gtsug tor nas gsang gnas rdo rje'i bar du brgyud nas byung ba'i khu ba des dbang bskur/ zhal phyag gi rnam pa can lha mo'i pad+ma nas 'thon te/ dbang stegs la 'khod par bsam/ khyad par cung zad ma gtogs nang dbang phyi ma gsum la'ang 'gre'o// dbang so sor bskur ba la/ gsol gdab dag bya lha ru bskyed// dbang rdzas lhar bskyed dbang bskur sbyin// lha dang bsre zhing dbang don bshad// 'og ma rnams kyang de bzhin no// zhes pa ltar las/ dang po chu'i dbang la/ bla ma dang sku rdo rje dbyer med pa la khams lnga'i dri ma sbyong byed chu'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod ces dang*/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ haṃ haṃ nas māṃ swā hā/ zhes pas gsol ba btab/ rnam rgyal dung chos dri bzang gi chus gang ba rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du bzhag de'i steng du rdo rje me tog gi phreng ba can bzhag la/ bum pa rnams yi ge drug pa dang swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ hāṃ las steng 'og gi bum pa nas/ sum gnyis tsam gang bar gyur/ slob dpon gyis oṃ nas k+ṣaḥdang*/ swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi lus kyi 'byung ba dang bum pa'i chu rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi lus kyi nam mkha'i khams dang*/ steng 'og gi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang gu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i nas 'dzin pa/ de bzhin du lus kyi rlung gi khams dang shar shar lho'i bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/

ī dang ral gri las skyes pa'i sgrol ma nag mo nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi me'i khams dang*/ lho lho nub kyi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ ṝ dang rin po che las skyes pa'i gos dkar mo dmar mo nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi chu'i khams dang*/ byang byang shar gyi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ ū dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i mā ma kī dkar mo nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi sa'i khams dang*/ nub nub byang gi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ l̥̄ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i spyan ma ser mo nas 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas hoḥ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa rnams yum lnga'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam/ de nas oṃ ā ī sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas bum pa'i chur gyur/ zhes brjod/ oṃ pradzñā sogs lan gcig gis 'og gi bum chu/ lo tsa ne dang mā ma kī dang paṇ+ḍa ra dang*/ tā ra rnams lan gnyis kyis rang rang gi phyogs mtshams kyi bum pa gnyis gnyis dang*/ badz+ra dha twī shwa rī lan gcig gis steng gi bum chu rnams bsdus la/ rnam rgyal chen po'i dung chos nang du blugs/ de nyid nas bum pa gzhan rnams su'ang bsre'o// de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha gshegs pa gshegs ma nas mchod pa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can gyi nas/ de ltar bdag la stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan dang na bza' dang rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur gum la sogs pas char 'bebs bzhin pas/

dri la sogs pas mchod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis yi ge drug gi sgra dang bcas pas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ yum rnams kyis bum pa dkar po byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba cung zad yo bar 'dzin pas dbang bskur bar mos la dngos su slob dpon gyis/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin zhing me tog gi char 'bebs pa dang bcas te/ bkra shis gang zhig zhes pa nas bkra shis shog oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho haṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes dang*/ yum rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas dung chos kyi chu lag tu thogs te khyed rnams la dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni sogs dang*/ yum lngas bum pas dbang bskur bar bsams la dngos su slob dpon gyis slob ma'i gtsug tor dang*/ phrag pa dang dpung pa'i tshigs dang*/ brla dang dpyi'i tshigs g.yas g.yon du reg cing dbang bskur ba kun la shes par bya zhing*/ oṃ ā ī sogs nas swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas/ khams lnga yum lngar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las yum lnga spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang yum lnga'i rnam pas khams lnga yum lngar gsal ba la thim par mos/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de ni byis pa skyes ma thag zhes pa nas chu'i dbang ngo*// cod paṇa gyi dbang la bla ma dang sku rdo rje dbyer med pa la phung po lnga'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa cod paṇa gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ aṃ iṃ nas ban+dha yan+tu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pa dang swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi phung po dang cod paṇa rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rnam shes kyi phung po dang cod paṇa ljang gu/

a dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa ljang gu/ ljang dmar dkar ba'i nas 'dzin pa/ 'du byed kyi phung po dang cod paṇa nag po/ i dang ral gri las don grub nag po nas 'dzin pa/ tshor ba'i phung po dang cod paṇa dmar po/ ṛ dang rin po che las rin 'byung dmar po nas 'dzin pa/ 'du shes kyi phung po dang cod paṇa dkar po/ u dang pad+ma las 'od dpag med dkar po nas 'dzin pa/ gzugs kyi phung po dang cod paṇa ser po/ l̥ dang 'khor lo las rnam snang ser po sogs nas dril bu 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas hoḥ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa rnams rigs lnga'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam/ oṃ ā ī sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon nas/ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod pa'i bar 'dra/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can nas gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma sogs nas/ bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ sangs rgyas lnga dang slob dpon lhan cig pas cod paṇa phyag tu thogs te khyed rnams la dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas sbyin par bya/ oṃ a i ṝ nas swā hā/ zhes dang gnas lngar bzhag ste mgo la bcings/ de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ ā ī ṝ ū l̥̄ pañtsa dhā tu sogs chus kyang dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las sangs rgyas lnga spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rigs lnga'i rnam pas phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gsal ba la thim/

mchod/ de ni byis pa'i gtsug phud bzhag pa nas cod paṇa gyi dbang ngo*// de ltar byang phyogs sku'i nas thob par byed do// de ltar byang phyogs su dbang gnyis kyis lus kyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ ngag gi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir las kyi rdo rje dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor gyis bskor ba byas nas/ lho sgor khrid par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ nas k+ṣaḥlho phyogs su 'khod/ bla ma dang gsung rdo rje dbyer med pa la ngag gi dri ma dag byed kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis/ oṃ nas k+ṣaḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams bsangs/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin lho phyogs gsung rdo rje'i zhal nas sogs/ pad+mar 'phros pa'i byang chub kyi sems de skad cig gis gsung rdo rje dmar po/ dmar dkar nag pa'i nas mā ma kī dkar mos 'khyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ nas pad+ma nas 'thon te/ dbang stegs la 'khod par bsam mo// dar dpyangs kyi dbang la/ bla ma dang gsung rdo rje dbyer med pa la rlung bcu'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa dar dpyangs kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ a ā nas phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pa dang swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi rlung bcu dang dar dpyangs rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rlung mnyam gnas dang rus sbal/ dar dpyangs nag po rnams a ha dang*/ spos snod dang rnga yab nag po las skyes pa'i nag mo 'bar ma dang*/ du ba ma nag mo nas 'dzin pa/ gyen rgyu dang rtsangs pa/ dar dpyangs dmar po nas 'dzin pa/ khyab byed dang lhas byin dar dpyangs dkar po nas 'dzin pa/ klu dang nor las rgyal dar dpyangs ser po nas 'dzin pa/

srog dang thur sel dar dpyangs ljang gu dang sngon po rnams hoḥphreṃ dang rdo rje dang gri gug las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug nas rin po che 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dar dpyangs su gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i nas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ nus ma bcu dang slob dpon lhan cig pas dar dpyangs phyag tu thogs te khyed rnams la dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang oṃ ā ā nas pū ra ṇi swā hā/ zhes gnas lngar bzhag ste dpral bar bcing*/ de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ ā ī sogs chus kyang dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas/ rlung bcu nus ma bcur gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las nus ma bcu spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang nus ma bcu'i rnam pas rlung bcu nus ma bcur gsal ba la thim/ mchod/ de ni byis pa rna ba 'bugs shing nas sa gsum pa thob par byed do// rdo rje dril bu'i dbang la/ bla ma dang gsung rdo rje dbyer med pa la rtsa ro rkyang gi dri ma sbyong bar byed pa rdo rje dang dril bu'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ hūm̐ hoḥbi dzñā na nas phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pas bsangs/ swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi rtsa ro rkyang dang dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rtsa ro ma dang rdo rje hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po sogs nas 'khyud pa/ rkyang ma dang dril bu ho dang gri gug las skyes pa'i sna tshogs yum nas 'dzin pa/ de gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bur gyur/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nas bgegs bskrad/ slob dpon dang gtso bo yab yum tha mi dad pas rdo rje dang dril bu phyag tu thogs te dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas sūr+ya tsan+d+ra bi sho dha ka swā hā/ zhes pas gnas lngar gtugs te spyi bor bzhag pa'i mthar lag pa g.yas g.yon du gtad la 'khyud pa'i tshul byar gzhug de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ ā ī sogs nas chus kyang dbang bskur bas/ rtsa ro rkyang gnyis gtso bo yab yum du gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las gtso bo yab yum spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang gtso bo yab yum gyi rnam pas rtsa ro rkyang gnyis gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba la thim/ mchod/ de ni byis pa dgod pa sogs nas sa bzhi pa thob par byed do// de ltar lho phyogs gsung gi zhal du nas 'bras bu thob bo// de ltar lho phyogs su dbang gnyis thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag par byas nas/ yid kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir las kyi rdo rje dang lhan cig dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor gyis bskor ba byas nas shar sgor khrid par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥnas k+ṣaḥzhes brjod pas shar phyogs su 'khod par bsam/ bla ma dang thugs rdo rje dbyer med pa la yid kyi dri ma dag byed kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis oṃ nas k+ṣaḥzhes brjod pas khyed rnams bsangs/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin shar phyogs thugs rdo rje'i nas/ pad+mar 'phros pa'i byang chub kyi sems de skad cig gis thugs rdo rje nag po nag dmar dkar ba'i nas spyan ma ser mos 'khyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ nas dbang stegs la 'khod/ brtul zhugs kyi dbang la/ bla ma dang thugs rdo rje dbyer med pa la dbang po yul dang bcas pa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa brtul zhugs kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ a ā sogs nas pa dan+tu swā hā/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pa dang swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi dbang po yul bcas mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rna ba'i dbang po dang yul chos mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams la a ā dang nas 'dzin pa/ sna'i dbang po dang yul reg bya/ mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams nas 'dzin pa/ mig gi dbang po dang yul ro/ mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams nas 'dzin pa/ lce'i dbang po dang yul gzugs mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi dbang po dang yul dri mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams nas 'dzin pa/ yid kyi dbang po dang yul sgra/ mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams/ aṃ aḥdang rdo rje las skyes pa'i kun tu bzang po dang sgra rdo rje ma'i bar bskyed/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas ye shes pa rnams sems dpa' sems ma'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ nas dbang rdzas mthe bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i nas bgegs bskrad/ sems dpa' sems ma dang slob dpon lhan cig pas mthe bo'i rdo rje phyag tu thogs te dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ 'di de sangs rgyas nas bi kha yen+d+ri ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes pas gnas lngar dbang bskur zhing lag tu byin/ de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ ā ī nas chus kyang dbang bskur dbang yul sems dpa' sems mar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las sems dpa' sems ma spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang sems dpa' sems ma'i rnam pas dbang yul sems dpa' sems mar gsal ba la thim/ mchod/ de ni byis pa 'dod yon lnga la longs spyod pa nas sa lnga pa thob bo// ming gi dbang la/ bla ma dang thugs rdo rje dbyer med pa la las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa'i dri ma sbyong bar byed pa ming gi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ha hā ya yā nas nā ma me da dan+tu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pa dang swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi las dbang bya ba dang*/ dbang rdzas gdu bu rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi gsang ba'i dbang po dang bya ba khu ba 'dor sdom byed pa/ gdu bu rnams ha hā dang rdo rje las/ gtsug tor can nas 'dzin pa/ kha'i dbang po dang bya ba bshang ba 'dor sdom byed pa/ gdu bu rnams nas 'dzin pa/ lag pa'i dbang po dang bya ba 'gro ba/ gdu bu rnams nas 'dzin pa/ rkang pa'i dbang po dang bya ba len pa/ gdu bu rnams nas 'dzin pa/ bshang lam gyi dbang po dang bya ba brjod pa/ gdu bu rnams nas 'dzin pa/ mchog gi dbang po dang*/ bya ba dri la 'dor sdom byed pa/ gdu bu rnams haṃ haḥdang rdo rje las gnod mdzes dang shin tu sngon mo sngo dmar dkar ba'i nas 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas ye shes pa khro bo khro mo'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ nas dbang rdzas gdu bur gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i nas/ bgegs bskrad/ khro bo khro mo dang slob dpon lhan cig pas gdu bu phyag tu thogs te dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas bi hā ra bi shud+dha swā hā/ zhes pas gnas lngar dbang bskur te rkang lag la bcing*/ de nas slob dpon de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyod lam gyi cha lugs su bsgyur te chos gos kyi grwa gzung ba'i khu tshur g.yon pa snying ga dang g.yas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgyas rigs dang rjes su mthun pa'i ming btags shing lung bstan par mos pa mdzod/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro nas bhur+bhu ba swaḥzhes brjod cing gsang mtshan dran par bya/ de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur bar mos/ oṃ ā ī sogs nas chus kyang dbang bskur/

las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa khro bo khro mor gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las khro bo khro mor spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang khro bo khro mo'i rnam pas las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa khro bo khro mor gsal ba la thim/ mchod/ de ni byis pa la ming btags pa nas sa drug pa thob par byed de ming gi dbang ngo*// de ltar shar phyogs thugs kyi zhal du nas 'bras bu thob par byed do// de ltar dbang gnyis kyis yid kyi dri ma dag par byas nas/ ye shes kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir/ las kyi rdo rje dang lhan cig pas dkyil 'khor la g.yas skor gyis bskor ba byas nas nub sgor khrid par mos nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ nas k+ṣaḥnub phyogs su 'khod/ bla ma dang ye shes rdo rje dbyer med pa la ye shes kyi dri ma 'khrud pa'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ byang chub rdo rje sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pas bsangs/ dri ma dang bral ba'i rang bzhin nub phyogs ye shes rdo rje'i nas/ byang chub kyi sems de skad cig gis ye shes rdo rje ser po nas sgrol ma nag mos 'khyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ nas dbang stegs la 'khod/ de nas rgyal ba'i bdag po rjes gnang 'dogs bcas rab tu sbyin/ zhes gsungs pas/ rjes gnang dngos dang de'i 'dogs gnyis las/ dang po chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang la gnas skabs su gdul bya so so'i bsam pa dang mthun par theg pa gsum po gang la gang 'dul ston dgos kyang*/ mthar thug de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang 'brel ba'i rdo rje theg pa bstan dgos shing*/ chos ston pa de rnams kyang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya dgos so zhes shes pa'i ched du/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes su gnang ba la bla ma dang ye shes rdo rje dbyer med pa la rjes gnang gi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/

maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ e waṃ pad+ma nas ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pa dang*/ swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi ye shes dang rnam shes phyag mtshan rnams mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi ye shes kyi phung po dang*/ rnam shes kyi khams phyag mtshan rnams/ haṃ k+ṣa dang rdo rje las rdor sems nas 'dzin pa/ de gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ nas rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ nas dbang rdzas phyag mtshan rnams su gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo nas/ bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum dang slob dpon lhan cig pas phyag mtshan phyag tu thogs te/ dbang bskur ba'i mos pa mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas sbyin par bya/ 'jig rten kun tu nas oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥdharma tsakra pra brta ka swā hā/ zhes pas gnas lngar dbang bskur/ de bzhin du chos kyi gnas su rdo rje/ ral gri/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ 'khor lo rnams dang*/ dharma'i gnas su badz+ra/ khat+ga/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ tsakra rnams bcug la phyag mtshan rnams rigs lnga so so'i ngo bor bsgoms nas gnas lngar bzhag de brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur/ oṃ ā ī nas chus kyang dbang bskur/ chags pa'i phung po dang yul rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum spyan drangs/ chags pa'i phung po dang yul rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba la thim/ de ltar khyed rnams rigs kyi bdag por dbang bskur nas sems can gyi don sgrub dgos shing*/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul yang*/ mdun nam stan du bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ/ zhes pas zhabs kyi 'og tu 'khor lo byin te/ gzhan don sgrub pa'i rgyu byang chub kyi sems dran par byas nas sems can 'khor ba las drongs shig ces pa'i don yin/

'dren lugs ji ltar byed na/ dbyangs tha ma ste aḥtsheg drag can las byung ba'i dung*/ oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su byin te/ sems can 'khor du bsdus nas chos smra bar gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ chos gang gis na/ dbyangs dang po ste a las byung ba'i rgyud kyi glegs bam/ a zhes pas lag pa g.yon du byin te/ chos 'di'i sgra sgrogs par gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ tshul ji ltar ston na/ aḥlas byung ba'i dril bu/ aḥzhes pas byin te dril bus shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa ltar/ zab mo'i de kho na nyid ston par gyis shig pa'i don yin pas/ 'khor lo bskor ba dang*/ dung 'bud pa dang*/ glegs bam klog pa'i tshul dang*/ dril bu 'khrol ba re mdzod cig thams cad nam mkha'i sogs nas/ da ni sems can don gyis shig /ces pa ste/ de'i don ni khyed rnams kyis sems can thams cad la chos kyi 'khor lo/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ ral gri'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ 'khor lo'i 'khor lo rnams bskor la/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis shig ces pa'i don yin/ de la khyed rnams kyis kyang thal mo sbyar te ji ltar gsung ba de ltar bdag gis bsgrub bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mnga' bdag gsung ba de ltar bgyi// zhes khas blangs so// gnyis pa rjes gnang gi yan lag dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang gnyis las/ dang po la/ sngags dang mig sman me long dang*// mda' gzhu rjes gnang rnam pa bzhi// zhes pa ltar te rgyud nas bshad pa'i las tshogs dang dngos grub bsgrub pa'i sngon du rang rang gi me tog phog pa'i lha'i bsgom bzlas 'gro dgos te/ des sangs rgyas thams cad bzlas pas mnyes nas byin gyis rlob par 'gyur bas/ khyed rnams la bgegs kyi bar chad med pa dang dman pa dang 'bring dang 'bring gi rab la sogs pa dngos grub gang 'dod pa thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ba dang*/

don dam pa'i sngags kyi dngos grub kyis zhing dag par bya ba'i ched du sngags kyi rjes gnang ngam bzlas lung gi don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung ste/ zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon la thim par mos nas sngags 'di rnams kyi rjes zlos mdzod/ ces dang snying po/ nye snying*/ rkang pa bdun bcu rtsa gnyis po rnams bzlas mthar/ de brtan pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis me tog sngags kyi phreng bar byin gyis brlabs nas khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag ste byin gyis brlabs par mos/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags sogs zhes brjod cing me tog mgo bor bzhag khyed rnams kyang slob dpon la me tog 'thor ba dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung sogs nas gsol/ de ltar las kyi tshogs rab 'byams la dbang bar byas nas/ gdul bya rnams gang dang gang gis 'dul bar 'gyur ba legs par shes par byas nas/ de dang de'i sgo nas sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang gi don du/ gser dngul gyi snod nas mar dang sbrang rtsi'i mig sman thur ma'am rdo rjes blangs te mig gi thad kar byug pa'i tshul bya zhing praṃ las byung ba'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i rang bzhin gyi thur mas mig sman blangs pa spyan gyi thad kar byugs pas ma rig pa'i ling thog bsal nas sems can gyi don la 'jug pa'i mthu dang ldan par byas par mos pa mdzod/ ces dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai tra sogs nas muṅgha ṭa yā mi swā hā/ zhes pas lha'i mig dang ldan par byas nas/ chos can gyi snang ba thams cad me long nang gi gzugs brnyan ltar shes pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don gyis shig ces shes pa'i ched du/ a las skyes pa'i me long bstan te/ a chos rnams gzugs brnyan nas sras su skye zhes pa ste de'i don ni/

kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad rgyu rkyen rten 'brel tshogs pa las me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar gsal zhing ma 'dres par du mar snang yang*/ yang dag par na nyon sgrib kyis dag cing*/ shes sgrib kyis rnyog pa med pas blos gzung du med cing*/ tshig gis brjod du med par rang gi ngo bo nyid kyis med cing*/ de med pas gang la brten pa'i gnas med pa'i phyir/ de ltar du chos thams cad shes par gyis la sems can gyi don byos shig des khyod skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sras su skye bar 'gyur ro zhes pa'i tha tshig go /de ltar shes par byas nas/ bdud bzhi las rnam par rgyal bar bya ba'i phyir chos kyi dbyings shin tu phra ba'i 'ben 'bigs pa'i sa bon gzhag pa'i ched du'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams sems can gyi don la rjes su chags shing thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i sgo nas don mdzad pa'i rjes su bsgrub dgos so// zhes ston pa'i ched du hoḥlas byung ba'i mda' gzhu byin te/ hoḥsarba ta thā ga tā na nu rā ga ya swa/ zhes pa ste/ rang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags par byos shig ces pa'i don yin pas/ thabs kyi mda' drug shes rab kyi gzhu la bkang ste phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og gnyis te drug tu 'phangs pas bgegs la 'bigs pa'i bsam pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rjes su chags par bgyi snyam pas/ sarba ta thā ga tā na nu rā ga ya mi/ zhes gsung zhing 'phen pa'i tshul re mdzod cig ces brjod/ de ltar nub phyogs ye shes kyi zhal du rjes gnang gi nas sa bdun pa thob par byed do// gnyis pa slob dpon gyi dbang la/ 'grel chen las/ de nas slob ma la lag par rdo rje dang dril bu byin nas/ che ge mo rdo rje/ de dag gis slob dpon te/ zhes gsungs pa'i don/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa ste/ de'ang rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du/ slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pas bsangs/

swa bhā was dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje hūm̐ las dus kyi 'khor lo nas 'khyud pa/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rjer gyur/ de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yas su rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig gi slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de sangs rgyas nas rtag tu bcang*/ zhes pas byin pa'i rdo rje de lan gsum gsor te snying gar bzung nas/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad pa zhu/ thog mtha' med pa'i nas dang po'i sangs rgyas so// zhes pa ste de'i don ni/ thog ma dang tha ma med pa'i sems kyi rgyun rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig par rnam par mi rtog pa'i byang chub kyi sems te/ de ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ dga' ba chen po dang kun tu bzang po la sogs pa mtshan gyi rnam grangs du ma dang ldan pa'i mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas nyid yin no zhes pa'i tha tshig go /dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du/ slob dpon gyis dril bu sngar bzhin bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dril bu aḥlas sna tshogs yum nas 'dzin pa/ de nyid zhu ba las byung ba'i dril bur gyur/ de nyid khyed rnams kyi phyag g.yon du dril bu gsung gi dam tshig gi slad du byin par mos pa mdzod/ 'di de nas rgyal bas bzhed/ ces pas byin pa'i dril bu de 'khrol zhing dku g.yon par bzung nas/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad pa zhu/ srid pa ngo bo nas byed par 'gyur/ zhes pas te de'i don ni/ srid pa 'khor bar skye ba'i rgyun ngo bo nyid kyis dag pa'i phyir/ bdag tu sgro btags kyang ngo bo nyid kyis srid pa dang bral bar byas so// de'ang rang bzhin gyis dag pa la dag par shes pa'i sems dang ldan pa ste/ des ni mchog gam dam pa'i srid pa mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'da' bar byed par 'gyur ro zhes pa'i tha tshig go

/phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gi slad du/ khyed rnams rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dus kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ye shes kyi phyag rgya sna tshogs yum gyi rnam par gsal btab nas phyag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba'i 'khyud rgya byas pas/ thabs shes rab phan tshun nu ma la sogs par reg pa'i bde ba nyams su myong bas byang chub kyi sems kyis lus thams cad la khyab par gyur pa mos te/ phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid brjod pa 'di la thugs gtad pa zhu/ yid kyi lus ni brtan pa nas/ dngos grub thams cad bsgrub par bya// zhes pa ste de'i don ni yid kyi lus te ye shes kyi phyag rgya'i dam tshig rang gi lhag pa'i lha yab yum kha sbyor gyi rnal 'byor dang nam yang ma bral bar bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi lus brtan par byed pa de la phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rab tu bsgrags pas na/ khyod kyis kyang dam tshig 'di dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/ 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad bde chen gyi lam du shes par byas nas mi spong bar longs spyod pa'i sgo nas dngos grub thams cad bsgrub dgos so zhes ston pa yin no// de nyid brtan pa'i slad du chus kyang dbang bskur ba ni/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes chus kyang dbang bskur/

'dir dbang lha spyan 'dren pa med kyang sngar rjes gnang skabs kyi dbang lha ma bstim pa de nyid 'dir bstim pa yin/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rdor sems yab yum gyi rnam pas khyed rnams rdor sems yab yum du gsal ba la thim/ de la nye bar spyod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod nas/ des khyed rnams kyis rdo rje slob dpon du dbang bskur ba thob pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi las su bya ba rnams tshul bzhin du bsgrub dgos par ston pa ni/ kye rdo rje che dang nas dbang ba'i slob dpon du 'gyur ro// zhes pa ste de'i don ni/ phyi brda'i rdo rje dril bu/ nang don gyi dang*/ gsang ba dbang gi dang*/ mthar thug de kho na nyid kyi rdo rje dril bu chen po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs dang gsung gi dam tshig tu zungs shig de'i steng du lus phyag rgya'i dam tshig rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du byin gyis brlabs pas/ deng nas bzung ste khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon nyid du gyur pa yin pas/ gdul byar gyur pa'i slob ma rnams la rnal 'byor rgyud man chad kyi dbang rgyud man ngag bstan pa'i sgo nas 'khor du bsdu bar gyis shig ces pa'i tha tshig go /de dag gis ni khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs nas byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun dang*/ de'i steng du rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang bcas thob pas rnal 'byor gyi rgyud man chad nyan pa dang 'chad pa la dbang ba dang*/ rnal 'byor bla med nas bstan pa'i sngags kyi dngos grub sgrub pa la dbang ba'i slob dpon du 'gyur ba yin no// de ltar khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon du gyur nas rnam par dag pa'i chos bstan par gdams pa ni/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag la gsan pas khyab par gda' ste/ rdo rje dril bu rab tu sbyin nas rab mchog sogs nas bskal pas min par rgyal bas gsungs zhes pa'i bar brjod de/

de'i don 'grel chen las/ da ni nges par rdo rje zhes pa la sogs pas rnam par dag pa'i chos bstan par gsungs te/ 'dir srog gcod pa la sogs pa'i dam tshig ni rnam pa gnyis te drang ba'i don dang nges pa'i don gyis phyi rol dang nang gi bdag nyid do// zhes gsungs te/ de'ang rdo rje dang ral gri dang rin po che dang pad+ma dang gri gug gi rigs rnams la drang ba'i don du 'chi ba'i mtha'i bar mtshams med pa lnga byed pa de'i tshe khro bo'i rigs la sngar bsgrub pa'i sngags dang mi bskyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis gsod pa dang*/ lam ma yin par lhung ba rnams mngon par gdon pa'i slad du rdzun gyi tshig smra ba/ yi dwags kyi 'gro bar 'gro ba bzlog pa'i don du ma byin par len pa/ dud 'gro'i skye gnas su 'gro ba bzlog pa'i don du gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa/ rigs su 'dzin pa rnam par gzhig pa'i slad du bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa'i dam tshig rnams bsten pa/ las kyi phyag rgya'i dngos grub kyi don du gdol pa mo la sogs pa mi smad pa/ rang don du ma yin par bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du sbyin pa chen po sbyin pas sngags rnams bsgrubs nas nus ldan du gyur na rnal 'byor pas thams cad bya bar bstan to// nges don du rang gi lus la srog bkag ste rnal 'byor pa'i khu ba gtsug tor du dgag pa srog gcod pa/ drang ba dang nges pa'i don gyis sems can thams cad kyi skad kyi tshig tu cig car chos ston pa dang*/ snying gar gzhom du med pa'i sgra bden pa min par smra ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i nor ni yon tan yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che ste/ de 'phrog pa mgrin par sa brgyad pa'i gnas su brtan pa gzhan gyi nor 'phrog pa/ phyag rgya mo 'phrog pa ni/ dpral bar sa bcu pa'i gnas su brtan pa gzhan gyi bud med 'phrog pa/ lhan cig pa'i dga' ba'i chang dang*/ go ku la sogs pa'i sgron ma lnga dang*/

bdud rtsi lnga'i sangs rgyas rnams te de phyi rol du mi 'dzag par lte ba'i bar bsten pa/ skye gnas su bsrubs pa phyi rol du khu ba mi 'pho bar tshangs par spyod pa/ sems can gyi don du nor la sogs pa'i bdog pa dang lhan cig tu rang gi lus bsod nams tshogs kyi don du sbyin par bya ba rnams bstan te/ mdor na bsod nams kyi tshogs dang*/ tshul khrims kyi tshogs dang*/ de las skyes pa'i ye shes ni ye shes kyi tshogs te tshogs gsum gyis rigs kyi bu khyod yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du mtha' yas pa'i bskal pas kyang 'grub par rgyal ba nyid kyis gsungs so zhes pa'i don to// de lta bu'i phyi dang nang gi dam tshig gi rnam par dag pa bstan nas/ dbang gi rnam dag bstan pa ni/ chu ni sgrol ma nas yang dag rab sbyin bya/ zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de'i don chu la sogs pa'i dbang bdun po de dag ni/ khams lnga dang*/ phung po lnga dang*/ rlung bcu dang ro rkyang gnyis dbang po yul bcas dang*/ las dbang bya ba dang bcas pa dang*/ rnam shes kyi khams rnams rnam par dag cing sgrib pa med par rig ma lnga/ rgyal ba lnga/ nus ma bcu/ nyi ma zla ba/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal mo chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i ston pa nyid do// des na sdig pa'i dri ma 'phrog pa'i dbang bdun bskur bas sa bdun pa'i dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur ro zhes dbang gi rnam dag dang*/ dbus nas sgo yi dang po'i nas dkyil 'khor chos kyi dbyings dang ldan zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de dag gi don ni phyi snod 'jig rten khams kyi rgya dpangs dang*/ nang bcud sems can gyi lus kyi khams dang lam dang 'bras bu'i chos kyi 'khor lo rnams dkyil 'khor du rnam par dag par bstan cing*/ bum pa rnams dang du ba la sogs pa nas 'gyur med ye shes dbye ba las/ zhes pa'i bar brjod de/

zhes pa de rnams kyi don ni phung khams skye mched bya byed du gtogs pa'i phyi dang nang gi chos su snang ba thams cad ni lhag pa'i lha gshegs pa gshegs ma/ sems dpa' sems ma/ khro bo khro mo la sogs pa dur khrod du bkod pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs kyi bar gyi lha'i 'khor lo rnam par dag pa yin no zhes rnam dag bstan pa'o// rnam dag bstan pa 'di rnams bshad pa rgyas par spros na shin tu mangs par 'gyur bas ma spros so// de ltar dkyil 'khor bzhi las zhes pa nas sa bdun pa thob par byed do// de ltar dbang bdun bskur bas rang rgyud la sangs rgyas kyis byin gyis brlabs pas sa bdun pa thob pa'i dbang phyug tu gyur snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nas prab+to3haṃ zhes so// gnyis pa dbang gi rgan gzhon shes pa'i don du/ dus go bar bya ba ni/ 'dir lo gang yin pa de brjod pa dang*/ rigs ldan gyi rgyal po sogs nas bdag gis lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ngo*// zhes pa'i bar gyis dus tshod sogs kyi dmigs bsal rnams brjod de/ dper na da lta'i me byi'i lo dang nag zla'i nya lta bu la mtshon na/ ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyi ma'i gnyen gyis dpa' bo zhes pa lcags 'brug gi lo'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la/ shrī dha nu ka ṭa ka'i mchod rten chen por chos rgyal zla bzang la sogs pa skal ldan gyi gdul bya rnams la rgyud kyi rgyal po dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsungs pa nas bgrangs pa'i lo nyis stong dang drug brgya so bdun pa dang*/ rgyud gsungs pa'i phyi lor chos rgyal zla bzang gis rtsa ba'i rgyud bsdus so// byang phyogs ka lā pa'i grong khyer du rigs ldan rnam gnon gdong lnga'i dbang po'i khrir phebs shing*/ dam pa'i chos bstan nas lo sum cu tham pa/ me mkha' rgya mtsho la 'das lo drug cu skor bdun dang nyag ma zhe lngar slebs pa/

rab byung bcu gsum pa'i 'dzin byed ces pa'i gnam lo shar ba/ rgyu skar nag pas nya ba'i zla ba/ dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum pa'i tshes/ res gza' lhag pa/ skar ma nag pa/ sbyor ba nges pa/ byed pa snga cha biṣ+ṭi phyi cha gdab pa rnams shar ba'i dus su mdo khams kyi sa'i thig le sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang du/ rdo rje slob dpon che ge mos/ slob ma'i gtso bo che ge mos thog drangs pa rnams la/ mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur te 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa nyid kyi bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob pa'i slad du bdag gis lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ngo*// zhes pa lta bu'i rigs 'gre shes par bya'o// gsum pa de lta bu'i dbang bdun thob pa'i phan yon nam 'bras bu ni/ rgyud las/ dbang bdun gyis ni mngon par dbang bskur dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun gyi ni dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur// zhes dbang bdun thob pas lam rim pa gnyis bsgoms na tshe 'di nyid la 'og min gyi srid pa'i mthar thug pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa chen po sa bdun gyi sems dpa' chen por 'gyur zhing*/ lam ma bsgoms kyang dbang thob nas mi dge bcu spong ba sogs dam tshig la gnas pas skye ba bdun gyis bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 'bras bu thob ste sa bdun pa'i dbang phyug tu 'gyur ba yin no// bzhi pa dam tshig bsrung bar bya ba rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi spang bar gdams pa ni tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsan pas khyab ste/ gal te g.yo sgyu'i dbang gis nas ma nur 'gyur te rdo rje'i theg par gnas pa rnams la'o// zhes pa'i don ni/

ji skad bstan pa'i rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig gi rtsa bar gyur pa ni ltung ba bcu bzhi po 'di rnams te/ de dag las gang byung yang dmyal bar 'gro ba la sogs pa sdug bsngal chen po 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur bas 'di dag spong ba'i sgo nas dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad srog las gces pa 'dzin dgos par ston pa ste/ gal te rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung na/ de 'dag par bya ba'i slad du dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir slar yang zhugs la dbang bskur ba legs par blangs te/ dam tshig rnams dag par bya ba la shin tu 'bad dgos te/ ci'i phyir na rdo rje theg pa'i lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba ni 'di nyid yin pa'i phyir ro zhes pa'i don to// de tsam gyis tshim pa'i slob ma rnams ni dam tshig bsdus te 'dzin par khas blangs nas yon phul te mjug gi cho ga rnams bya'o// gnyis pa dbang gong ma bskur ba'i cho ga la slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma la bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang sbrel nas byed pa'i skabs yin na/ dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bdun blang ba dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ltar nyams su blangs nas/ de'i steng du dbang gong ma gong chen bdag po chen po'i dbang du bcas par bdag 'jug gi tshul du len pa'i cho ga yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba/ kun mkhyen bu ston pa'i gsung rab kyi bzhed pa ji lta ba bzhin du kho bos logs su bris pa ltar ngag 'don du nyams su blang bar bya'o// gnyis pa slob ma la bya ba ni/ dbang snga ma rnams kyis smin par byas pa'i slob ma rnams khrus byas nas gral du 'khod pa la slob dpon gyis nyan pa po rnams la sems bskyed gsal gdab tu bcug ste/ de la 'dir skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag thog mar mchog gi dang po'i sangs rgyas zhes bya ba dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor chen por legs par zhugs te/ ji skad du rgyud las/

dbang bdun gyis ni mngon par dbang bskur dge ba'i dbang gis sa bdun gyi ni dbang phyug nyid du 'gyur// zhes dbang bdun thob pas lam rim pa gnyis la 'bad par byas na/ tshe 'di nyid la 'og min gyi mthar thug pa 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa 'grub pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi 'dren pa chen po sa bdun gyi sems dpa' chen po 'thob par 'gyur ba'i skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la/ de'i steng du dbang gong ma bzhi bskur ba la/ sems can gzhug pa'i don dang*/ lam yongs su shes pa'i don dang*/ rgyud nyan pa la dbang ba'i ched du drang ba'i don gyi dbang gong ma bzhi dang*/ slob dpon chen po'i gnas sbyin pa'i don dang ston pa po'i ched du dbang gong ma'i gong ma bzhi ste gnyis dang*/ de'i steng du'ang rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang bskur ba dang gsum las/ 'dir dang po ste/ de la'ang bum pa dang*/ gsang ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa dang bzhi yod pa'i dang po bum pa'i dbang la/ gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur sbyin// dbang don bshad cing nga rgyal gzung*// 'og ma gsum yang de bzhin no// zhes pa ltar las/ snod dang mi ldan pa'i skye bos dben pa'i sa phyogs su/ skrag pa dang 'khrul pa'i skyon dang bral ba'i rig ma lo bcu gnyis ma nas nyi shu'i bar lon pa/ dbang gis smin pa zhig bla ma la dbul bar mos te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la bum pa'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal mkhyen rab pa'i lhan thabs su dbang gong ma bzhi la rim pa ltar/ bla ma sku rdo rje/ gsung rdo rje/ thugs rdo rje/ ye shes rdo rje dang dbyer med pa la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba gsungs 'dug mod/ gzhung chog tu bum pa gsang ba gnyis la bla ma gtso bo'i nga rgyal dang ldan par bshad pa'i shugs las gzhan gnyis la'ang de ltar yin dgos pas/ dbang gong ma thams cad la slob ma'i dmigs pa 'pho ba ma gtogs/

slob dpon gtso bo'i rnal 'byor kho na gnas pa yin pas maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba'ang 'di ltar byed pa legs so// dbul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom pa yi// dus kyi 'khor lo khyod la 'dud// mchog tu mi 'gyur bde ba rdzogs// ye shes sku nyid khyod la 'dud// stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa// byang chub sems ni 'gyur med gang*// dbang bskur de yis bdag la ni// mgon po da ni bka' drin mdzod// bu dang chung ma sogs bcas pa// bdag ni dus kun khyod kyi 'bangs// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag la skyabs gzhan yod ma yin// zhes dang*/ khyad par bum pa'i dbang bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ oṃ oṃ shes rab thabs dag kye// bum pa'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol// oṃ pradzño pā yau ka la sha a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ de nas slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang tha mi dad pas/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma zhig sprul te khyed rnams la gtad par mos/ lha mo dga' ster gnas ster ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa dag tu byos// zhes pas gtad pa/ khyed rnams sku rdo rje'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rig ma tha mal gyi rang bzhin dag pa'i lha mo gos dkar mor gsal ba la/ sgeg pa dang chags pa'i nyams dang bcas pas thog mar nu ma la reg cing*/ de nas dgod pa dang lag pas 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar gyis shig de ltar byas pas phyi rol gyi yul sna tshogs la dmigs pa'i rtog pa rags pa 'gags/ dga' ba'i bde ba rang rig pa ni/ nu ma la reg pa las thob pa'i phyir bum pa'i dbang ste/ ji skad du/ dpal ldan shes rab nu ma la yang dang por reg pa gang yin bum pa'i dbang ni de nyid do// zhes gsungs pas so// dgod pas dga' ba thob pa yon tan gnyis kyi bdag nyid dag pa'am shes rab la 'khyud pas dga' ba thob pa ni slob dpon gyi dbang ste/

dgod pas dga' ba thob pa ni// dgod pa dag la slob dpon nyid// ces dang*/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud// rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba// slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces pas so// de ltar na lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam bsnyen pa'i yan lag nyan shes bsgom pa la dbang*/ sprul sku dang sku rdo rje'i sa bon 'jog 'bras bu sa brgyad pa thob/ gsang sngags kyi dge tshul du gyur pa yin no// des bum dbang thob pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sras sa brgyad pa thob bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ oṃ rdo rje sems dpa' yis// rdo rje bum pa'i dbang gis dbang*/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra satwe na badz+ra ka la sha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa/ a bhi bskur nas rdo rje sems dpa'i sras// mi g.yo ba yi sa thob nga*/ ṣik+to badz+ra satwa pu tra a tsa la bhū mī lab+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ba rnams ni bum pa'i dbang ngo*// gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang la'ang*/ gong du bshad ma thag pa lta bu'i rig ma zhig bla ma la dbul par mos te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas khyed rnams sku rdo rje'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom sogs gong ltar dang*/ khyad par gsang ba'i dbang bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ āḥshes rab thabs dag kye/ oṃ āḥpradzño pā yau gu h+ya a gsang ba'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab/ sngon chad gsang ba'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i brdar/ oṃ dwā da sha nas phaṭa ces gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo dang rig ma sna tshogs yum du gsal ba'i shes rab kyi pad+ma a las nas spras pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje hūm̐ las nas mtshan pa/ zhes pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba ltar brjod pas snyoms 'jug bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum gtsug tor nas zhugs/ snying gar snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos zhu ba a wa dhū tī nas brgyud de/ rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba brtan par byas pa/ pad+ma nas phyung ste slob dpon rang gi mthe bong dang ming med kyis blangs pa de nyid khyed rnams gsung rdo rjer gsal ba'i ljags thog tu byin te dbang bskur bar mos/

bdud rtsi khar blud cing*/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis// ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur// de bzhin byang chub sems bzang pos// bu khyod la ni dbang bskur bya// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ zhes pas byin pa'i bdud rtsi de nyid sangs rgyas thams cad zhu ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang slob dpon gyi byang chub kyi sems dbyer med par mos te/ a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod cing myang ngo*// shes rab kyis kyang gos dang bral bas thig le chu skyes na gnas pa blangs te ljags thog tu byin zhing dbang bskur bar mos pa mdzod/ 'di de dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams// dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste// khams lnga ldan pa'i ro rtogs byed// bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis// oṃ phreṃ bi shwa mā ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin pa de/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor mos te a ho ma hā su kha zhes brjod cing myang ba zhu/ de ltar myangs pas longs spyod kyi 'khor lo tshim par nyams su myang ba dang*/ dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ di byen+d+ra ya sogs kyis mig dar phye ste/ phyag rgya'i chu skyes la bltas pas 'dod chags cher g.yos te rtog pa phra ba phal cher 'gags/ mchog dga'i ye shes rang rig pa ni rdzas dang gnas gsang ba las thob pa'am/ bltas pas dga' ba thob pa yon tan gsum gyi bdag nyid dag pa gsang ba'i dbang ste/ lta bas dga' ba thob pa ni// lta ba gsang ba de bzhin no// zhes so// de ltar gsang ba'i dbang po'i dkyil 'khor du gsang dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma 'khrud/ lam nye bar bsgrub pa'i yan lag bsgom pa la dbang*/ gsung rdo rje longs sku'i sa bon 'jog 'bras bu sa dgu pa thob par byed/ gsang sngags kyi dge slong du gyur pa yin no// des gsang dbang thob pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sras rgyal bu gzhon nu sa dgu pa thob bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ āḥrdo rje sems dpa' yis// gsang ba'i dbang gis dbang bskur te//

oṃ āḥbadz+ra satwe na gu h+ya a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to/ badz+ra rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po'i bu// gzhon nu sa dgu thob pa nga*/ satwa yu ba rā dzo na ba bhū mi lab+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal gzung ba rnams ni gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la'ang rig ma dbul ba dang*/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyed rnams gsung rdo rje'i nga rgyal la gnas bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad sogs dang*/ khyad par shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ huṃ thabs dang shes rab dag oṃ huṃ pradzño pā yau badz+ra rdo rje sems dpa' sna tshogs yum// kye dag shes rab ye shes kyi// mngon par dbang bskur bdag la stsol// satwa bi shwa mā ta rau/ pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me da dā tāṃ huṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba btab/ sngon chad phyag rgya'i bha ga'i dkyil 'khor 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ oṃ dwā da shas mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas khyed rnams kyis slob dpon la phul ba de'am/ yang na sprul pa'i rig ma yid du 'ong ba lo bcu gnyis nas nyi shu'i bar lang tsho dar la bab pa zhig dang bcas te/ slob dpon gyis ji ltar skal ba ngan pa'i sems can 'di ni sgom pa sogs la 'di dbang ba dang*/ rgyud mnyan pa'i slad du ste/ sems can rnams la rgyud bstan pa dang dkyil 'khor bri ba'i slad du ni ma yin no zhes bsams la/ 'dir ni khyed rnams dpang po yin// bdag gis 'di la 'di gtad do// zhes bla mas rgyal ba rnams dpang du byas la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong 'di khyod kyis// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags// 'khor lo rim pa'i rab sbyor gyis// bde ba dam pa myang bar gyis// rdo rje skyil krung gis sems ni// nor bu'i nang du gnas par blta// zhes gsung zhing khyed rnams la gtad par mos pa mdzod/

des kyang lus gur gum la sogs pa dri zhim pos byugs/ gcer bur byas nas rtsa mchog tu rgyas pa'i chu skyes khyed rnams la ston bzhin pas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad yang dag ldan// gang zhig cho gas bsten byed pa// de yi mdun na bdag gnas so// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mnyes byed sogs// pad+mar bya ba ji bzhin gyis// rang nyid bde chen rgyal po ste// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// bhañdza mok+ṣa hoḥzhes brjod cing dpang du byon par mos/ de nas khyed rnams thugs rdo rje dang rig ma lha mo spyan mar gyur par bsams pa ni sprul sku lam du byed pa lha'i 'du shes/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ/ gsang bar swā/ gtsug tor du hā/ gtsug tor gyi 'khor lo dang rna ba'i dbang po la/ ā a las rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma dang mi bskyod pa ljang gu rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ dpral ba'i 'khor lo dang sna'i dbang po la/ ī i las sgrol ma dang don grub nag po ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo dang mig gi dbang po la/ ṝ ṛ las gos dkar mo dang rin 'byung dmar po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ snying ga'i 'khor lo dang lce'i dbang po la/ ū u las mā ma kī dang 'od dpag med dkar po pad+ma dang tho ba 'dzin pa/ lte ba'i 'khor lo dang lus kyi dbang po la/ l̥̄ l̥ las spyan ma dang rnam snang ser po 'khor lo dang dung 'dzin pa/ gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo dang yid kyi dbang po la/ aḥ.aṃ las gshin rje ma dang rdor sems sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ snying gar oṃ hṛlaṃ hṛ dā yā na maḥ mgo bor oṃ hūm̐ shi ra se swā hā/ gtsug tor la oṃ hṛrāṃshi kha yai po ṣa ṭa/ yan lag thams cad la oṃ hriṃ ka ba tsa ye hūm̐/ mig la/ oṃ hrāṃ ne trā ya wa ṣa ḍa/ phyogs thams cad du oṃ hraḥ.as+t+rā ya phaṭa/ dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug tor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥrnams bkod cing byin gyis brlabs/ shes rab kyi pad+ma a las pad+ma 'dab brgyad huṃ las byung ba'i rdo rjes spras pa/ thabs kyi rdo rje huṃ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga āḥlas pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan par bsams pa ni/ longs sku lam du byed pa sngags kyi 'du shes/ gan+dhaṃ la sogs pas mchod de/ thabs 'di la brten nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o snyam pa ni/ chos sku lam du byed pa chos kyi 'du shes te/ 'du shes sum ldan sngon du 'gro bas rig ma'i lus la reg pa dang tsum+ba na la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ shī shī shī ha ha ha swā hā/ zhes dang*/ slar yang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags pa rdo rje'i rang bzhin nga'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ khyed rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas lus byin gyis brlabs shing*/ bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis kyang sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam zhing*/ de'ang bla ma'i man ngag las dga' ba'i dbye ba shes par byas la/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ni/ shes rab ma la mig gis bltas pas rang gi yid la 'dod pa bskyod pa ste 'dod chags g.yos pa'i bde ba ni dang po dga' ba'o// shes rab ma la 'khyud pa la sogs pa dpral bar byang chub kyi sems rdzogs pa ste gang ba'i bde ba ni gnyis pa mchog dga'o// phan tshun snyoms par zhugs pa'i dpral ba nas byang chub kyi sems zhu bar gyur pa yan lag mchog ste rdo rje nor bu'i bar 'dzag pa'i bde ba ni gsum pa khyad par dga' ba'o// de gsum gyi mthar phyir ma 'dzags par thig le bzhi pa 'byung ba'i dus ni oṭ+ṭa ste lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba nyid de/

de rnams ngos bzung zhing nus pa ji lta bar bzung la dal bus btang ste chu skyes nas blangs la btung ngo*// de dag las rtog pa mtha' dag 'gags/ dbang po gnyis las skyes par 'gyur ba'i bde ba rtogs pa/ khyad par dga' ba nyams su myong ba ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ste/ lag bcangs las dga' ba thob pa yon tan bzhi'i bdag nyid kyang ste/ lag bcangs dga' ba thob pa ni// lag bcangs dag la shes rab nyid// ces so// dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ di byen+d+ra sogs kyis mig ras phye/ de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gsum pa thob/ yid kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam sgrub pa'i yan lag la dbang*/ thugs rdo rje dang chos sku'i nus pa 'jog sa bcu pa thob/ gsang sngags kyi gnas brtan rgan por gyur pa yin no// des shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur bas rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa sa bcu pa thob bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ huṃ rdo rje sems dpa' yis// shes rab ye shes dbang gis dbang*// bskur nas rdo rje 'chang gnyis pa// chos kyi sprin gyi sa thob nga*/ oṃ huṃ badz+ra satwe na pradzñā dzñā na a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to/ dwī tī ya badz+ra dha ro haṃ dharma me gha bhū mi lab+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ba rnams ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa la/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyed rnams thugs rdo rje'i nga rgyal la gnas pas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ sngon chad don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba'i mtshon byed du/ oṃ dwā da sha nas phaṭa/ ces gsung zhing mig ras rnams 'ching bar zhu/ de nas khyed rnams ye shes rdo rjer gsal ba la dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas ngo sprad pa ni 'di lta ste/ nor bu'i nang du chud pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi bde ba rtogs pa bzhi pa'o zhes gsungs te/

de'i don ni/ khyed rnams kyis dbang gsum pa'i dus su khyad par gyi dga' ba nyams su myong ba'i mthar thig le 'dzag pa gsum gyi rjes su/ byang sems rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor rgyas te phyir ma zag pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba cha bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa'i bde ba chen po ni dbang bzhi pa yin la/ de nyid gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa las bde ba thob pa yon tan lnga dag pa'i bdag nyid kyang de ste/ gnyis gnyis sprad las bde thob pa// gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa de bzhin nyid// de ltar dbang ni rnam pa bzhi// zhes so// dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ di byen+d+ra sogs kyis mig dar phye/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ ye shes kyi dri ma 'khrud/ lam sgrub chen la dbang*/ ye shes rdo rje dang lhan cig skyes dga'i nus pa 'jog sa bcu gnyis pa thob bo snyam du nga rgyal bzung ba rnams ni dbang bzhi pa'o// dbang gong chung yan chad las mi byed na/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal la sogs pa rnams bya'o// de ltar de yan chad thob pa'i slob ma la dbang gong chen dang sbrel nas byed na/ de la gnyis/ thun mong gi bya ba dang*/ dbang so sor bskur ba gnyis kyi dang por rig ma'i dbye ba dbul ba ni/ de'ang slob ma 'grel bshad dang bcas pa'i rgyud thams cad thos shing shes par gyur pa na/ bdag po chen po'i slad du/ slob ma khyim pa yin na rang gi rigs las skyes pa'i rig ma/ tsha mo dang ni bu mo dang*// sring mo de bzhin skyed byed ma// de bzhin chung ma'i ma dang ni// de bzhin zhang po'i bud med dang*// pha yi spun zla'i chung ma dang*// de bzhin pha yi sring mo dang*// rang gi ma yi spun zla nyid// rang gi chung ma mchog gzugs can// sgrol ma la sogs chos khams mthar// rang rigs las skyes rig ma bcu// thar pa 'dod pa'i khyim pa yis// dbang gi dus su rab sbyin bya// zhes te/

de dag kyang tsha mo sogs sgra ji bzhin pa ma yin gyi/ rang rigs las skyes pa'i bu mo lo bcu gcig ma nas nyi shu ma'i bar bcu bla ma la dbul bar bya zhing*/ rab byung la ni dmangs rigs sogs las skyes pa'i bu mo lo bcu gcig ma nas nyi shu ma'i bar bla mas sbyin par bya ste/ dkyil 'khor du ni dbang bskur ba'i// dmangs rigs skyes sogs gzhan dag gis// dge slong dge tshul rnams la ni// bla mas sbyin bya mi yi bdag /rlung sogs rim pas dmangs rigs mo// rgyal rigs de bzhin bram ze mo// rje mo gdol mo nya pa mo// gar ma de bzhin tshos mkhan mo// ko lpags byed ma gtum mo ni// chos khams mthar skyes ma ste bcu// rig ma chen mor yang dag brjod// longs spyod grol 'bras rab tu ster// zhes pa ste/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa bcu dang*/ sa bcu dang*/ dbang bcu dang*/ stobs bcu dag pa'i rig ma bcu bla ma la 'bul bar bsams nas bka' stsal zhu ba ni/ kye bcom ldan 'das pha rol tu phyin pa thams cad thob bo// da ni bdag gis ci zhig bgyi// zhes zhus pa dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ bcu'i nang nas rang gis chung ma 'di bzung nas/ rang gi rig ma dang lhan cig tu bdag la gsol ba gdab par byos shig ces pa ni bka' stsal sbyin pa'o// gnyis pa dbang so sor bskur ba la bzhi las/ dang po bum dbang la sngar ltar bzhi'i dang po ni/ khyim pas rang gi chung ma/ rab byung gis gtum mo rang gi chung mar bsgoms pa dang lhan cig gser gyi maṇ+ḍal byas te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la gong chen gyi bum dbang zhu ba'i yon du sogs maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad nas yod ma yin/ zhes dang*/ bum pa'i dbang bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ oṃ nas phaṭa/ ces gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

bla ma dang dus kyi 'khor lo dbyer med pas khyed rnams khyim pa la lo nyi shu ma/ rab tu byung ba la gdol pa mo rig mar gtad pa sgra rdo rje ma sngon mor gsal ba dang*/ shar du lo bco lnga ma sgrol ma nag mo/ lhor lo bcu gnyis ma gos dkar mo dmar mo/ byang du lo bcu gsum ma mā ma kī dkar mo/ nub tu lo bcu bzhi ma spyan ma ser mo/ shar lhor lo bcu drug ma reg bya rdo rje ma nag mo/ lho nub tu lo bcu bdun ma ro rdo rje ma dmar mo/ byang shar du lo bco brgyad ma gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo/ nub byang du lo bcu dgu ma dri rdo rje ma ser mo ste/ rnal 'byor ma'i 'khor mo gcer mo skra grol ba/ phyag na gri gug dang thod pa can bkod la/ rig ma dgu po re re nas rim pa bzhin du/ rgyan thams cad bsal zhing gcer bur byas nas/ khyed rnams la gtad par mos/ lha mo dga' ster nas dag tu byos/ zhes pas rim gyis gtad pa/ khyed rnams phyag rdor ljang gu'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ rig ma tha mal gyi rang bzhin dag pa'i sgra rdo rje ma sngon mor gsal ba la sgeg pa dang chags pa'i nyams dang bcas pas nu ma la reg tu gzhug cing*/ dgod pa dang lag pas 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong bar mos/ slar yang khyed rnams rnam snang ser po'i nga rgyal gyis/ shar gyi rig ma lo bco lnga ma sgrol ma nag mor gsal ba la reg cing dgod pa dang 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong*/ khyed rnams 'od dpag med dkar po'i nga rgyal gyis/ lho'i rig ma lo bcu gnyis ma gos dkar mo dmar mo la reg cing*/ dgod pa dang 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong*/ khyed rnams rin 'byung dmar po'i nga rgyal gyis/ byang gi rig ma lo bcu gsum ma mā ma kī dkar mo la reg nas myong*/ khyed rnams don grub nag po'i nga rgyal gyis/ nub kyi rig ma lo bcu bzhi ma spyan ma ser mo la reg nas myong*/ khyed rnams sgrib sel ser po'i nga rgyal gyis/

shar lho'i rig ma lo bcu drug ma reg bya rdo rje ma nag po la nas myong*/ khyed rnams 'jig rten dbang phyug dkar po'i nga rgyal gyis/ lho nub kyi rig ma lo bcu bdun ma ro rdo rje ma dmar mo la nas myong*/ khyed rnams sa snying dmar po'i nga rgyal gyis/ byang shar gyi rig ma lo bco brgyad ma gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo la nas myong*/ khyed rnams nam mkha'i snying po nag po'i nga rgyal gyis/ nub byang gi rig ma lo bcu dgu ma dri rdo rje ma ser mo la reg cing dgod pa dang 'khyud pa'i dga' ba nyams su myong ba sogs nas/ slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod// ces so// bum pa'i dbang la bla ma las slob ma chung ma'o zhes gsungs pa ni bum dbang bskur bas bla ma las slob ma chung ma ste gsang dbang gi snod du rung zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi kun spyod la ma dad pa mi skye ba'i dag par bya'o// de ltar lus kyi dkyil 'khor nas a tsa la bhū mi lab+dho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ba rnams kyis gong chen gyi bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang la/ rig ma 'bul ba dang*/ gong chen gyi gsang dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba gdab pa/ mig ras 'ching ba rnams 'dra zhing*/ rig ma lo bcu gnyis ma nas nyi shu ma'i bar/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa la bla ma dus kyi 'khor lo dang rig ma sna tshogs yum du gsal btab pa'i pad+ma dang rdo rje byin rlabs sngar bzhin byas nas snyoms 'jug bya zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā nas āt+ma ko3haṃ/ slob dpon gyi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i rigs lnga yab yum gtsug tor nas zhugs te snying gar snyoms 'jug gi bde ba chen pos zhu ba'i bar sngar gyi gsang dbang gi skabs ltar las/ khyad par ni/ bla mas shes rab kyi nā ra na si ka ste rtsa dbu ma'i mas sna rdo rjes gzhib par byas te/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i rdo rje slob ma chung ma ste dag pa'i khar gzhug ste/

de las babs pa'i byang chub kyi sems khyed rnams gsung rdo rjer gsal ba'i ljags thog tu bzhag par mos pa mdzod/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs dang*/ gsang rdzas ster ba'i tshe bdud rtsi las rdo rje'i rtses blangs pa sbyin pa ma gtogs nga rgyal bzung ba'i bar gzhan thams cad sngar gyi gsang dbang ltar brjod pa ni gong chen gyi gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa shes rab ye shes kyi dbang la/ gsol gdab dbang bskur tshogs 'khor gshegs// sdom pa sbyin dang rab byed bstan// dbang don bshad dang nga rgyal bzung*// zhes pa ltar drug las/ gong chen gyi shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol gdab mig ras 'ching ba rnams sngar gyi shes rab ye shes ltar byas la/ de nas gsang dbang gi dus su slob dpon gyis gang la 'khyud pa de'am/ yang na slob ma'i chung ma lo nyi shu ma la slob dpon gyis 'khyud de/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su khyed rnams la gtad de dbang sbyin zhing*/ de nas lo bcu gcig ma ma gtogs pa rnams gang dang gang la 'dod pa spyod par nus pa'i slob ma la de dang de gtad pa yin te/ mtshan mo phyed nas chu tshod gnyis nas nyi ma 'char ba de srid du'o// de'ang slob dpon

'di 'dra zhig yod na legs sam snyam yang dkyus su ma byung bas ma byas kyang chad skyon ci mchis/ gyis ji ltar skal ba can 'di ni slob dpon chen po'i gnas sbyin pa'i don dang ston pa po'i slad du'o snyam pas/ 'dir ni khyed rnams nas 'di gtad do// zhes bla mas rgyal ba rnams dpang du byas la/ gzungs ma yid 'ong nas blta/ zhes gsung zhing khyed rnams la gtad par mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyis kyang lus sogs nas bhañdza mok+ṣa ho/ de nas khyed rnams rang rang so so'i thabs su gsal ba dang shes rab rnams kyang rang rang gi phyogs su 'khod pa sngar bzhin gsal gdab pa'i dpral bar oṃ nas gsang bar k+ṣaḥshes rab rnams kyi pad+ma a las nas 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ gan+dhaṃ la sogs pas mchod la/ thog mar lo nyi shu ma dang de nas lo bco lnga ma dang lo bcu gnyis ma nas lo bcu dgu ma'i bar gyi rnal 'byor ma rnams sgra rdo rje ma sogs dang rang nyid so so'i thabs su gsal btab nas bum dbang gi skabs ltar reg cing snyoms par zhugs par bsams la/ oṃ shī shī nas sangs rgyas yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa dang ro gcig tu gyur par bsam zhing*/ de'ang bla ma'i man ngag las dga' ba'i dbye ba ngos bzung ba'i bar sngar gyi shes rab ye shes kyi skabs ltar brjod do// de ltar dga' ba'i dbye ba ngos bzung nas tshogs 'khor gshegs pa chu tshod gnyis kyi rting ma la nyi ma 'char ba tsam nas tshogs kyi 'khor lo gshegs su gsol/ de nas sngar gyi dbang bzhi pa don dam min par bstan pa ni/ kun rdzob tu khyad par gyi dga' ba'i mthar lhan cig skyes pa'i skad cig bdag gis brjod pa gang yin pa 'di dang*/ thig le gsum gyi mthar gang yin pa de ni don dam par mi 'gyur te zhes pa'i don/ sngar gyi dbang bzhi pa'i skabs su khyad par dga' ba'i mtha' dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi thig le 'dzag pa gsum gyi mthar thig le bzhi pa 'byung ba'i dus su lhan cig skyes pa'i skad cig nyams su myong ba de don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa ma yin te de ni rgyud nyan pa la dbang ba'i don du kun rdzob drang ba'i don gyi dbang yin no// don dam gyi dbang 'pho med du bstan pa ni/

don dam par rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi bde ba ni 'pho ba med pa'o zhes pa'i don/ don dam pa'i bde ba ni phyag rgya chen mo bsgoms pa las skyes pa'i mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba yin no zhes pa'o// 'dzag pa bsrung bar gdams pa ni/ des na bde ba chen po 'di ni khyod kyis bsrung bar bya'o// de bzhin du dang po'i sangs rgyas las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa/ las kyi phyag rgya rab sbyor dang nas// pad+ma'i phyi rol rang lces blangs// zhes pa ste/ de'i don ni bde ba chen po byang chub kyi sems ni phyi rol du mi 'pho bar brtul zhugs brtan pos bsrung ba bya ste/ bsrung ba 'di kho nas skye ba 'di la sangs rgyas nyid du byed de/ des tshul khrims kyi tshogs rdzogs shing*/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gsum dang ldan pas rang gzhan gyi don lhun grub tu 'byung ba/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa'i bdag nyid rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes kyang 'di yin la/ sdom pa'ang 'di yin pas bu khyod kyis legs par srungs shig ces pa'i don yin no// de nas dbang gi rab byed bstan pa la/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la dbang gi rab byed zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la dbang gi rab tu byed pa'i bka' drin mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis/ bu khyod nyon cig kun rdzob ji lta ba bzhin du sems can thams cad kyi thun mong gi sogs nas bde ba gang yin pa de ni shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba'o zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ zhes gsungs so// dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ di byen+d+ri sogs kyis mig dar phye/ de ltar kun rdzob nas lab+dho3haṃ/ zhes pa'i bar gyi dbang don bshad pa dang nga rgyal bzung ba rnams sngar dang 'dra'o// bzhi pa dbang bzhi pa la/ 'grel chen las/
