de ltar don dam pa'i le'u lnga pa las/ phyag rgya chen mo'i ye shes rgya cher brjod par bya ste/ des na 'dir rgyas par ma byas so zhes dbang chog gi skabs su don dam pa'i dbang bzhi pa sbas nas gsal bar ma gsungs shing*/ 'og tu kha 'phangs pa de 'dir gsal bar bstan par bya ba la/ gsol ba gdab cing dbang bskur bya// dbang don bshad cing nga rgyal bzung*// zhes pa ltar las/ gong chen gyi dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom sogs dang khyad par rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya chen po ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba bdag la stsal du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ ho shes rab thabs bdag nyid/ oṃ ho pradzño pā ya āt+ma kaṃ badz+ra satwa ma hā rdo rje sems dpa' phyag rgya che/ mu drā/ dzñā na a bhi ṣe kaṃ me pra yats+tsha oṃ āḥhūm̐ ye shes mngon par dbang bskur ba// bdag la rab tu stsal du gsol/ ho phaṭa/ ces pas gsol ba gdab/ mig dar 'ching ba 'dra/ de la 'dir/ dbang gnyis su dbye ba ni/ 'dir ni dbang bskur rnam pa gnyis kyang bu yi yon tan dbang gis 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'o// zhes/ slob ma 'jig rten pa'i dngos grub 'dod pa'i don du 'jig rten pa'i dbang dang*/ bla na med pa'i lam 'dod pa'i yon tan gyi dbang gis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang ngo*// 'jig rten pa'i dbang ngos bzung ste lam gyi rgyur bstan pa ni/ gang zhig shes rab kyi ni nu ma la reg gzhan pa sogs nas gang zhig 'gyur ba med pa'i bde ba de ni bzhi pa de yang de bzhin nyid kyi dbang bskur ba'o zhes so// sngar gyi chags bral dang po chags pa che zhes sogs dang*/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med ces sogs tshigs su bcad pa gnyis kyang don dam pa'i dbang byang chub sems kyi rdo rje gzhom du med cing 'gyur ba med pa nyid dang*/

rdul phra rab kyi chos nyid las 'das pa'i rtog pa dang bral zhing rnam kun mchog las mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba'i bsam gtan de'i rtse mo 'chang ba'i don du'o// des na dbang bzhi pa de phyag rgya chen mo bsgom zhing dbang la zhugs pa las thob pa yin na/ de'i sgom thabs dang 'jug thabs gang yin zhe na/ 'di nyid sgrub par byed pa ni// bsam med snang ba rnams kyis bya// zhes dang*/ rang gi sems 'di'i snang ba la gzhug par bya ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ lus mnyam par bzhag pa'i spyod lam dang ldan pa/ ngag rlung rgyu ba sor gzhag nam mkhar kun nas zhen pa'i sems dang mig ni mi 'dzums zhes gsungs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbyings su sems rtse gcig tu zhog mig kyang de nyid du hrig ger 'dzums pa med par ltos/ bsam pa thams cad yongs spangs te// nyi ma gcig ni yongs su brtag /ces gsungs pas/ rnam rtog gi spro bsdu thams cad dor nas cir yang mi sems/ cir yang mi 'dzin/ yid la byed pa thams cad spangs nas stong pa nyid zab mo dmigs pa med pa shes par byas nas/ rten med du lhod kyis klod la zhog mdzod/ ces brjod de cung zad mnyam par 'jog tu gzhug go /de ltar rim gyis bsgoms pas dbang bzhi pa rgyud la skye bar 'gyur ro// dbang de thob pa'i brdar/ oṃ de byen+d+ra sogs kyis mig dar phye/ de ltar don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dbang bzhi pa tshig gi sgo nas thob ces sogs nas/ gsang sngags kyi skye dgu'i bdag po chen por byed do// de ltar dbang gong ma bzhis tshul khrims kyi tshogs dang*/ ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs par byed pa yin no// de nas chos kyi dbyings 'gyur ba med pa'i dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ bcu gnyis pa/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba dus kyi 'khor lo'i go 'phang thob bo snyam pas/ 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ho chos dbyings 'gyur med pa// bzhi pa'i dbang gis dbang bskul te/

oṃ ho dharma dhā twa k+ṣa ra tsa tur+tha a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣik+to// bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa' nga*// bcu gnyis pa yi sa la bkod/ badz+ra sa twe na āt+ma nā haṃ dwi tī yo dwa da sha bhū mi lab+dho3haṃ/ badz+ra satwa ma hā ar+thaḥpa ra ma a k+ṣa raḥtrai lo kya rdo rje sems dpa' don chen mchog /mi 'gyur 'jig rten gsum po las/ bi rnam par rgyal ba dus 'khor lo// e waṃ yi ge'i bcom ldan 'das/ dza yaḥkā la tsakra bha ga wān e waṃ kā raḥzhes nga rgyal bya ba rnams ni dbang gong ma las gong ma'i dbang ngo*// gsum pa rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang bskur ba la gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro dam bca' ba ni de ltar dbang gong ma rnams thob nas rgyud thams cad shes shing*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi bya ba nus pa'i slob mas dam 'cha' bar gnas pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ kye dpal ldan bla ma khyed kyi zhes pa nas mi bgyi'o// zhes pa ni yon tan dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams dam bca' ba la gnas par byas pa yin/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba la/ gsol gdab dbang stegs so sor gzhag /so sor dbang bskur rjes gnang sbyin// rnam dag bstan cing sku gsung thugs// rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin dang drug /de la lhar bskyed phyag rgya byin// so sor dbang bskur nga rgyal bzung*// dbang don bshad dang lnga yin no// zhes pa ltar las/ thog mar khyed rnams kyis bla ma dang gtso bo dbyer med pa la/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bcug nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ sgrib pa thams cad bcom sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa khyed rnams dbang stegs so so la gzhag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du mnyam pa'i sa la/ dge slong la dbang stegs khru bzhi par re khā lnga dang ldan pa'i dbus su shing stan gyi steng du khru gnyis pa'i sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad mtshan ma lnga dang bral ba/

dge tshul gyi rten can rnams la khru gnyis par re khā lnga dang ldan pa'i dbus su pad+ma med pa'i shing stan du bcas pa/ khyim pa'i rten can rnams la ba lcis byugs pa khru gang par re khā gsum dang ldan pa shing stan med pa'i phal pa'i stan du bcas pa'i dbang stegs so so'i rnam pa can gyi steng du khyed rnams rten dge slong dang dge tshul dang khyim pa rnams so sor 'khod pa thams cad kyang slob dpon gyis yi ge drug pas bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla nyi sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang nyid hūm̐ dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba nas snyoms par 'jug pas gnas pa'i sku'i rnam pa can re rer gyur par mos pa mdzod/ gsum pa de rnams la dbang so sor bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa'i thugs ka nas/ dge slong gi rten can rnams la bu mo rgyud 'grel gnyis ka nas 'di bzhin bshad pa dang*/ kun mkhyen bu ston pa'i dbang chog tu'ang 'di kho na bzhin byung bas/ da lta'i phyag len la slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ thugs ka nas bu mo dang gzhon nu ma rnams skabs su gang bab kyi grangs dang mthun par sprul te/ de rnams kyis bum pa sogs dbang rdzas rnams thogs nas dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa dpon slob gnyis kas ma chad par mdzad nas/ dngos su slob dpon gyis dbang bskur ba dang dbang rdzas sbyin no/ gzugs mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bu ma skyes pa'i rnam pa can brgyad dang*/ gzhon nu ma skye gnas ma nyams pa'i rnam pa can gnyis rnams sprul te bum pa brgyad dang*/ rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis te bcu thogs nas dbang bskur zhing khrus byas/ mgo bor cod paṇa dang dar dpyangs/

lag tu phyag rgya ste mthe bo'i rdo rje bcings te khrus bya ba dang*/ dge tshul gyi rten can rnams la bu mo bzhi dang*/ gzhon nu ma gnyis kyis bum pa bzhi dang rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis te drug gi chu dang*/ dar dpyangs dang*/ phyag rgya byin te khrus bya ba dang*/ khyim pa'i rten can rnams la bu mo gcig dang*/ gzhon nu ma gcig gis bum pa gcig dang rgyal rnam rgyal bum pa ste gnyis kyi chu dang*/ phyag rgya byin nas dbang bskur zhing khrus byas nas dbang len dgos pas/ de ltar nges par byas nas/ de'i cho ga rnams dngos su slob dpon gyis bgyi ba yin te/ de'ang*/ chu dang cod paṇa dar dpyangs dang*// mthe bo rdo rje'i dbang bzhi la// gsol gdab slob ma dbang rdzas bskyed// so sor dbang bskur dbang lha bstim// zhes pa ltar las/ dang por dge slong dang dge tshul dang khyim pa'i rten can gsum la skur byed mang nyung gi khyad par tsam min pa so sor chu'i dbang bskur dgos pas na/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med pa la chu'i dbang zhu ba'i don du thal mo sbyar te/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ oṃ haṃ haṃ hiṃ hiṃ nas gha ṭair a bhi ṣiñtsan+tu maṃ swā hā/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ rnam rgyal dung chos chus gang ba rgyal ba'i bum pa'i steng du bzhag pa sogs sngar ltar byas la/ bum pa rnams sngags gnyis brjod pas bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ hāṃ las steng 'og gi bum pa nas lha'i dal 'gro'i chus sum gnyis tsam gang bar gyur/ slob dpon gyis/ yi ge drug pa dang*/ swa bhā was khyed rnams kyi lus kyi 'byung ba dang bum pa'i chu rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi lus nam mkha'i khams dang steng kun mkhyen bu ston gyis/ skabs 'dir de rnams kyi cho ga ni sngar dbang bdun gyi skabs su bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin du'o zhes pa tsam las gsal bar ma gsungs shing*/

de ji lta ba bzhin byas na gong gi dbang bdun gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar 'dir yang blang rgyu'i brda tsam las mi dgos mod/ rnam par dpyad na dbang bdun dbang gong ma dang bcas pas dbang bskur ma thag pa'i slob ma la/ dbang rdzas rnams lha'i rang bzhin du byas nas gtad pas rdo rje slob dpon gyi go 'phang mnga' gsol ba tsam zhig byed pa 'dir yang 'thad dam snyam pa dang*/ bla med kyi rgyud sde spyi 'gros dang yang mthun che bar sems shing sngon gyi zin bris 'gar yang bum pa dang bcas pa'i dbang rdzas 'di thams cad la dbang rdzas bskyed cing slob ma bskyed pa mi mdzad pa'ang yod ces pa'ang byung zhing*/ slob ma'i khams dang phung po sogs gsar du sbyang bsgyur rung mi dgos par sems so// 'on kyang ku sa li'i yig cha dang mthun par da lta'i bla ma'i phyag len gyi rgyun du'ang mchis pas de ltar byas so// de'i dbang du byas na 'byung ba dang khams sogs shin tu cha phra ba sbyong ba'i dgongs pas yin nam snyam/ 'og gi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i rdo rje dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma ljang gu nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi rlung gi khams dang shar shar lho'i bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ ī dang ral gri las skyes pa'i sgrol ma nag mo nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi me'i khams dang lho lho nub kyi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ rī dang rin po che las skyes pa'i gos dkar mo nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi chu'i khams dang byang byang shar gyi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ ū dang pad+ma las skyes pa'i mā ma kī nas 'dzin pa/ lus kyi sa'i khams dang nub nub byang gi bum chu dung chos kyi chu dang bcas pa/ lī dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i spyan ma nas 'dzin pa/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas hoḥ'i bar brjod/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes pa rnams yum lnga'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥhī/

dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa ro mnyam/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed pa la bcug de nas/ oṃ ā ī sogs kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas bum pa'i chur gyur ces brjod/ oṃ pradzñā pā ra sogs kyis bum chu gong ltar bsre/ de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha gshegs pa gshegs ma sogs kyis spyan drangs nas mchod pa'i bar gong bzhin bya/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas sogs brjod/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma rnams kyis gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan na bza' dang*/ rol mo'i sgra dang glu dang gar dang me tog dang gur gum la sogs pas char 'bebs bzhin pas mchod/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad brjod/ khro bo khro mo rnams kyis bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad pa dang bcas te dbang bskur bar mos/ zhes brjod la/ gan+dhaṃ sogs dang*/ me tog 'thor zhing dril bu'i sgra dang bcas te/ bkra shis gang zhig nas ho haṃ k+ṣaḥzhes pa'i bar brjod do// dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i bla ma'i thugs ka nas dge slong gi rten can rnams la bu mo gzugs mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bu ma skyes pa'i rnam pa can brgyad dang*/ gzhon nu ma skye gnas ma nyams pa'i rnam pa can gnyis rnams sprul te/ de rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas gshegs ma lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi chus gang ba'i bum pa brgyad dang rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis te bcu phyag tu thogs nas dbang bskur/ dge tshul gyi rten can rnams la'ang dmigs pa gzhan gong ltar dang*/ yum rnams dang*/

bla ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bu mo bzhi dang gzhon nu ma gnyis lhan cig pas gshegs ma lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi chus gang ba'i bum pa bzhi dang rgyal rnam rgyal gnyis te drug phyag tu thogs nas dbang bskur/ khyim pa'i rten can rnams la/ yum rnams dang bu mo gcig dang gzhon nu ma gcig lhan cig pas bum pa gcig dang rgyal rnam rgyal te gnyis phyag tu thogs nas dbang bskur bar mos pa bya dgos pa yin pas/ khyed rnams rang rang gi rten dang mthun pa'i dmigs pa so sor byas/ slob dpon gyis cho ga zor yang ba'i ched du stabs cig byas nas so so'i sgos chos kyi 'byin 'jug rnams byed pa yin pas/ de rnams thugs la zhog mdzod/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs nas bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dang gnas lngar bzhag ste dbang bskur ba'i mthar/ dbang bskur zhing khrus byas pas khams lnga yum lngar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor pas yum lnga spyan drangs pa dang dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rigs lnga'i rnam pas khams lnga yum lngar gsal ba la thim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod/ de ni dge slong dang dge tshul dang khyim pa'i rten can rnams la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i ched du chu'i dbang bskur ba yin no// 'og ma rnams la'ang skur byed nam mkha'i lha tshogs rnams kyis mchod pa dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ yi ge drug pa brjod pa rnams dngos su mi brjod pa ma gtogs pa des 'gre'o// gnyis pa dge slong gi rten can kho na la cod paṇa gyi dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ iṃ iṃ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis sngags gnyis brjod pas khyed rnams kyi phung po dang cod paṇa rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rnam shes kyi phung po dang cod paṇa ljang gu/ a dang rdo rje las mi bskyod pa ljang gu nas 'dzin pa sogs kyis lha rnams so sor bskyed pa'i gnas rnams byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes pa rnams rigs lnga'i rnam pas bcug pa dang dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur ba rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa/

mchod pa'i bar rigs 'gre/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod paṇa du gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas mchod/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' sems ma nas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad de/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bu mo brgyad dang gzhon nu ma gnyis rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas gshegs pa lnga'i rang bzhin can gyi cod paṇa phyag tu thogs te/ dge slong gi rten can kho na la dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas pa ri shud+dha swā hā zhes pas gnas lngar bzhag mthar mgo la bcing*/ de brtan pa'i slad du oṃ ā ī sogs chus kyang dbang bskur/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gnas gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las sangs rgyas spyan drangs pa dang dbang gi lha rnams kyang rigs lnga'i rnam pas phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gsal ba la thim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod/ de ni dge slong gi rten can rnams la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i ched du cod paṇa gyi dbang bskur ba yin no// gsum pa dge slong dang dge tshul gnyis so sor dar dpyangs kyi dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ a ā aṃ sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis sngags gnyis brjod pas khyed rnams kyi rlung bcu dang dar dpyangs rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rlung mnyam gnas dang dar dpyangs nag po rnams a ha dang*/ spos snod rnga yab nag po las skyes pa'i nag mo 'bar ba mo dang du ba ma nag mo nas 'dzin pa/ gyen rgyu dang rtsangs pa dar dpyangs dmar po rnams aḥhaḥsogs kyis lha rnams bskyed pa'i gnas byin gyis brlabs nas ye shes pa rnams nus ma bcu'i rnam pas bcug pa dang dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/

rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ de la mchod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dar dpyangs su gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sogs kyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas mchod/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can sogs/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad ces sogs nas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bu mo brgyad dang gzhon nu ma gnyis rnams slob dpon lhan cig pas nus ma bcu'i rang bzhin can gyi dar dpyangs phyag tu thogs te/ dge slong gi rten can rnams la dbang bskur/ dge tshul gyi rten can rnams la bu mo bzhi gzhon nu ma gnyis rnams lhan cig pas dar dpyangs phyag tu thogs nas dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje nas pa ri pū ra ṇi swā hā zhes pas gnas lngar bzhag mthar dpral bar bcing*/ de brtan pa'i slad du oṃ ā ī sogs chus kyang dbang bskur/ rlung bcu nus ma bcur gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las nus ma bcu spyan drangs pa dang dbang gi lha thams cad kyang nus ma bcu'i rnam pas rlung bcu nus ma bcur gsal ba la thim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod/ de ni dge slong dang dge tshul gyi rten can so so la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i ched du dar dpyangs kyi dbang bskur ba yin no// bzhi pa dge slong dang dge tshul dang khyim pa'i rten can gsum so sos phyag rgya'i dbang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ a ā e ai sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis sngags gnyis brjod pas khyed rnams kyi dbang po yul bcas dang mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi rna ba'i dbang po dang yul chos mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams ā ā dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i phyag na rdo rje dang chos dbyings rdo rje ma nas 'dzin pa/

sna'i dbang po dang yul reg bya mthe bo'i rdo rje rnams e e dang ral gri las skyes pa'i nam mkha'i snying po dang reg bya rdo rje ma nas kun tu bzang po sgra rdo rje ma'i bar gyi lha rnams bskyed/ de rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ nas ye shes pa rnams sems dpa' sems ma'i rnam par bcug pa dang dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ de la mchod de/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas mthe bo'i rdo rjer gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sogs kyis dbang lha spyan drangs nas mchod/ khyed rnams la dbang bskur ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ rdo rje can sogs zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad sogs nas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i bu mo brgyad dang gzhon nu ma gnyis rnams dang slob dpon lhan cig pas sems dpa' sems ma'i rang bzhin can gyi mthe bo'i rdo rje phyag tu thogs te dge slong gi rten can rnams la dbang bskur/ dge tshul gyi rten can rnams la bu mo bzhi dang gzhon nu ma gnyis te drug dang bcas pa khyim pa'i rten can rnams la bu mo gcig dang gzhon nu ma gcig ste gnyis dang bcas pas mthe bo'i rdo rje thogs te dbang bskur bar mos/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs dang*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad sogs nas bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dbang bskur ba'i mthar lag tu byin la/ de brtan pa'i slad du/ oṃ ā ī sogs chus kyang dbang bskur/ dbang yul sems dpa' sems mar gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las sems dpa' sems ma spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang sems dpa' sems ma'i rnam pas dbang yul sems dpa' sems mar gsal ba la thim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod do// dge slong la ched du brjod cing bsngags pa ni/

gdug pa bsdigs par byed pa'i mchog nas/ khyod ni mngon sum sangs rgyas sras// zhes gsungs te de'i don ni/ de ltar dbang bskur bas dge slong gi rten can gyur pa khyed rnams stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can gyi slob dpon du byin gyis brlabs pas na/ deng phyin chad stong pa dang snying rje rgyun mi chad pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don byed pa por gyur te/ de'i mtshan mar rdo rje dril bu mi 'bral bar bzung nas/ tshul ji lta bus 'dul bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos gzhan rnams la ston pa'i slob dpon thu bo'am/ gnas brtan rgan po'ang yin la/ srid pa'i zug rngu nyon mongs pa dang rnam rtog gi zag pa zad pa'i dgra bcom pa/ gcig tu gzhan la phan par byed pa khyod ni mngon sum du sangs rgyas kyi sras su gyur to// zhes pa'i don to// de bzhin du dge tshul la sems dpa' sems ma dang sprul pa'i bu mo bzhi dang gzhon nu ma gnyis dang khyim pa so sor sems dpa' sems ma dang bu mo gcig sogs sngar gyi rigs 'gres brda sprod cing dbang bskur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang de nyid du thim par bsams la mchod/ de ni dge slong dang dge tshul dang khyim pa'i rten can so so la rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i ched du phyag rgya ste mthe bo'i rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba yin no// bzhi pa rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ 'grel pa las/ rgyud bstan pa'i don du gsung ngam/ rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i don/ slob ma de gsum so so la rjes gnang gi dbang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ e waṃ pad+ma badz+ra sogs kyis gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis sngags gnyis brjod pas khyed rnams kyi ye shes kyi phung po dang rnam shes kyi khams phyag mtshan rnams mi dmigs te stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khyed rnams kyi ye shes kyi phung po dang phyag mtshan rnams haṃ k+ṣa dang rdo rje las rdor sems dang shes phyin ma bskyed nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas phyag mtshan rnams su gyur pa'i bar dang*/

bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo sogs nas bar chad kyi bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyis rigs lnga so so'i ngo bo can gyi phyag mtshan rnams phyag tu thogs te/ dbang bskur rdo rje dang*/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad ces pa nas 'khor lo'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ oṃ haṃ k+ṣaḥtsakra tsakra pra brta ka swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar brjod de phyag mtshan rnams gnas lnga dang lag tu bzhag ste dbang bskur/ de brtan pa'i slad du oṃ ā ī sogs chus kyang dbang bskur/ chags pa'i phung po dang yul rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gyur/ de'i 'od kyis dkyil 'khor las rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum spyan drangs pa dang*/ dbang gi lha rnams rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi rnam pas/ chags pa'i phung po dang yul rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum du gsal ba la thim/ de la mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod/ de ltar khyed rnams rdo rje slob dpon bdag por dbang bskur nas sems can gyi don sgrub dgos shing*/ ji ltar sgrub pa'i tshul yang*/ mdun du bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i 'khor lo/ oṃ badz+ra he tu māṃ zhes sogs nas sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga yā mi/ zhes gsung zhing phyogs bzhi steng 'og rnams su mda' re 'phangs par bsams pa'i bar rjes gnang rnams gzhung ltar sbyin no// 'on kyang der sngags kyi rjes gnang dkyus ltar bya ba'am/ mi nus na dus zhabs pas 'dams ka mdzad pa ltar/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin te zhi dang rgyas dang dbang sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o// de nas lung bstan pa ni/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi chos gos kyi grwa bzung*/ g.yas pa mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ khyed rnams so so'i ming nas lung bstan par bsam zhing*/ srid pa'i ngan 'gro nas bhu waḥswaḥgang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams dang lhan cig pas mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no zhes pa'i bar ro// yang na dus zhabs pa'i dkyil chog las 'byung ba ltar na/

lung bstan pa dang dbugs dbyung dang*// mig thur rmongs pa spang ba dang*// me long ye shes dbang dang ni// chos dang 'phrin las gnang ba dang*// slob dpon gyi ni las rnams dang*// dam tshig rnams ni bsgrag par bya// zhes gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang na/ dang po lung bstan pa ni/ bshad ma thag pa ltar bya'o// gnyis pa dbugs dbyung ni 'og tu 'byung ngo*// gsum pa mig thur gyi dbang ni/ oṃ nai tra nas ḍ+gha ṭa yā mi zhes pa'i bar dang*/ bzhi pa me long gi dbang ni/ āḥyis bsngags pa'i me long*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// zhes pa nas/ skyob pa rnams kyi sras su skye// zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod/ lnga pa chos 'khor bskor ba'i rjes gnang ni/ oṃ e waṃ pad+ma sogs kyis gsol ba gdab pa nas/ mnga' bdag gsung ba de ltar bgyi// zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya ba ni rgyas pa yin no// bsdus pa la dga' na de'i gong mtha' rnams dor la/ 'jig rten kun la thams cad nas// tsakra tsakra pra war+t+ta ka swā hā/ zhes pa'i bar gyi tshigs bcad dang sngags tsam brjod/ rgyas bsdus gnyis ka ltar yang*/ drug pa phrin las brgyad sgrub pa sngags kyi rjes gnang ngam/ yang na cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu sbyin te/ tshig 'di dag la gsan pas khyab ste/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang*// gsod dang bskrad pa thams cad de// las de rnams ni bsgrub par gyis// zhes pa ni sangs rgyas kyi phrin las brgyad po de dag gi sgo nas sems can gyi don rgya chen po sgrubs shig ces pa ste/ phrin las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ bdun pa slob dpon gyi las su bya ba de kho na nyid bcu shes nas slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ dbang gi don du sa ni yongs brtag sogs nas zhi ba la sogs mtha' dag rab tu bya// zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ de'i don ni/

khyed rnams kyis slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi dang*/ las dang mthun pa'i thab kyi dbye ba dang*/ bum pa dang dkyil 'khor gyi rgyu tshad mtshan nyid la sogs pa dang*/ sbyin sreg dang phur bu gdab pa sogs la shin tu mkhas par byas nas dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ de'i cho gas mngon par dbang bskur ba dang*/ zhi sogs las kyi tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa'i sgo nas sems can gyi don rab tu bya dgos so zhes slob dpon gyi las su bya ba'i dam tshig rjes su gnang ba ste rjes gnang gong 'og gnyis gang mos shig bya'o// lnga pa dbang gi rnam dag bstan pa ni/ dang por chu dag la ni dge bsnyen nyid sogs nas gnas brtan zhes par 'gyur ba ste// zhes gsungs te/ de'i don ni/ 'dir dang por dbang bdun po chu'i ming can dag la mngon par dbang bskur bar gyur pa ni sa bdun par lung bstan pa'i phyir dge bsnyen du 'gyur ro// bum pa la yang dge tshul dag tu 'gyur te/ mi g.yo bar lung bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi sras te gzhon nu zhes pa'i don to// gsang ba'i dbang la dge slong du 'gyur te/ legs pa'i blo gros su lung bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas kyi rgyal tshab nyid do// gong ma gsum pa'i byed pa ste shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba ni gnas brtan zhes pa chos ston par byed pa dang slob ma'i byed pa por 'gyur te/ chos kyi sprin du lung bstan pa'i phyir sangs rgyas gnyis pa nyid do// de bzhin du mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ 'jig rten gsum na gzhon lus nas/ gsum na mdzes zhes dang*/ phyir mi ldog pa phyir mi 'ong nas/ bsil bar gyur pa rnyog pa med// ces dang*/ mgo zlum brtul zhugs chen po nas/ zhi ba nyid/ ces pa'i bar brjod de/ zhes pa rnams kyang slob dpon gyi dbang gi rnam par dag pa nyid du gzung ngo*// shong pa lha dang dkyil 'khor dang dam tshig gi rnam dag ston pa ltar na'ang 'dir sngar bzhin brjod do// drug pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba ni/

de nas sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rjer byed pa'i slad du rdo rje sku'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya'o zhes gsungs pa'i don du/ khyed rnams dus kyi 'khor lo yab yum gyi skur gsal ba la phyag rgya drug sbyin pa ni/ rus pa'i 'khor lo bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo

ku sa li rgyal mtshan bzang pos/ haṃ las byung ba'i spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo a dang rdo rje las skyes pa'i mi bskyod pa sogs so sor sa bon mi 'dra ba gnyis phyag mtshan bcas pa las phyag drug bskyed par bshad mod/ 'dir sa bon tsam las bskyed pa bu ston gyi gzhung gtso bor bzung nas bkod pa yin/ haṃ las skyes pa'i spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo mi bskyod pa ljang gu zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas/ hoḥthugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros ye shes pa rnams mi bskyod pa'i rnam par dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhī/ dam tshig pa dang ye shes ro mnyam/ bum pa'i chus kyang oṃ ā ī sogs kyis dbang bskur/ rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab/ gan+dhaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas spyi gtsug gi 'khor lo'am nor bur gyur/ de nyid khyed rnams kyi spyi bo'i rgyan du byin par mos/ mi bskyod 'khor lo'i gzugs nas 'gro ba'i don byed 'gyur/ oṃ haṃ badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi ra si hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas spyi bor bcing*/ rna rgyan bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las haṃ haḥlas skyes pa'i rna rgyan 'od dpag med sogs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rna rgyan du gyur/ dpag med rna cha'i nas don byed 'gyur/ oṃ haṃ haḥbā ma dak+ṣi ṇa kar+ṇa yo ra sogs kyis rna cha g.yon dang g.yas su byin/ de bzhin du mgul rgyan bsang sbyangs/ oṃ las skyes pa'i mgul rgyan rin 'byung sogs nas/ rin chen mgul rgyan nas chu bzhin 'jug par 'gyur/ oṃ aḥkaṇ+ṭha badz+ra kaṇ+ṭhi ke hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas mgrin par byin/ gdu bu rnams bsang sbyangs/ a ā las byung ba'i lag gdub dang*/ ha hā las byung ba'i rkang gdub gnyis l̥ dang 'khor lo las skyes pa'i rnam snang sogs nas/ rnam snang lag gdub nas sa ltar brtan par gyur/ oṃ a ā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa ka ra yor sogs dang*/ rnam snang rkang gdub nas brtan par 'gyur/

oṃ ha hā bā ma dak+ṣi ṇa pā da yor sogs kyis lag pa g.yon dang g.yas dang rkang pa g.yon dang g.yas su byin/ ska rags bsang sbyangs/ aḥlas skyes pa'i ska rags don grub sogs dang*/ don yod nas rlung gis 'gro ba 'dul/ oṃ aṃ kaṭ+yaṃ badz+ra me kha le hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas sked par byin/ thal chen bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las stong chen yi ge lnga 'dus pa'i waṃ las skyes pa'i rdo rje sems dpa' sogs nas dbang rdzas thal chen du gyur/ byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin nas yid kyis 'gro ba 'dul/ oṃ waṃ pañtsa ā kā ra ma hā shū n+ya swa bhā wa sarbaṃ ge bhasma hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas byin/ de nas rdo rje mchod phyir thogs gser gyi rang bzhin nam/ skud pa'i rang bzhin can/ tshangs pa byed pa'i slad du ste sku rdo rje byed pa'i slad du sbyin par bya'o zhes pa'i don du/ stong pa'i ngang las a āḥ.aṃ las skyes pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ sku rdo rje bskyed pa sogs byas la/ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod phyir thogs su gyur/ de nyid khyed rnams kyi sku'i rgyan du byin par mos/ 'di la mkhyen rab pa dang ku sa li gnyis kas dpal ldan sku'i rdo rje sogs tshigs bcad dang sngags bcas pas sbyin par mdzad 'dug kyang*/ tshigs bcad ni gsol gdab kyi tshig tu yod pas mchod phyir thogs dang rdo rje dar dpyangs sogs la slob dpon slob ma gang gis kyang gsol ba gdab par mi rigs te/ bems dngos rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ bu ston gyis kyang sngags kyis byin la/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho ga rgyas par bya zhes gsungs pa tsam las ma bshad pas 'di bzhin byed pa 'thad par sems so/ /oṃ a aḥ.oṃ sarba swa ri ka tri sogs kyis do shal du byin nas/ sku byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa yongs su gyur pa las/

sku rdo rje dkar po sogs nas shes rab ma dang bcas pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar spros/ sku rdo rjes gdul bar bya ba'i sems can rnams la chos bstan nas/ slar log ste khyed rnams kyi mdun du 'khod pa la/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par mos/ gan+dhaṃ sogs brjod/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pa 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sku'i rigs kyi lha mo rnams kyis oṃ ā ī nas dha ni swā hā zhes bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur zhing bkrus/ khyed rnams kyi dpral bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la sku rdo rje rnams 'jug par gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan sku'i rdo rje nas deng bdag mdzod/ ces brjod pas ro mnyam par gyur te khyed rnams kyi lus sku rdo rjer gyur par mos/ gsung rdo rje rnam par dag par byed pa'i slad du ste dbang phyug chen po byed pa'i slad du'o zhes pa'i don du/ me tog phog pa'i lha gtso bo'i phyag mtshan/ rdo rje bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje āḥdang pad+ma las skyes pa'i gsung rdo rje dmar po dmar dkar nag pa'i zhal gsum phyag drug nas 'dzin pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ sogs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ oṃ shrī kā la tsakra huṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phyag g.yas su byin/ bcom ldan bdag gis sbyin lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥhakaṣamalawarayaṃhūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing me tog la mngon par bsngags pa'i rang gi lha'i snying po khyed rnams kyi spyi bor byin par bsam mo// gsung byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin par raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du āḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad yongs su gyur pa las gsung rdo rje sogs nas bkrus/ khyed rnams kyi mgrin par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gsung rdo rje rnams 'jug par gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

dpal ldan gsung gi rdo rje nas khyed rnams kyi ngag gsung rdo rjer gyur par mos/ khyab 'jug byed pa'i slad du ste thugs rdo rje byed pa'i slad du'o// zhes pa'i don du/ dar dpyangs dang cod paṇa bsang sbyangs/ aṃ las skyes pa'i dar dpyangs dang haṃ las skyes pa'i cod paṇa thugs rdo rje nag po nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dar dpyangs dang cod paṇa rnams su gyur/ oṃ aṃ badz+ra paṭ+ṭa ur+dhe hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ he badz+ra shi ro ma ṇi shi sa ra si hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas mgo bor byin nas/ thugs byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar thig le las sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa yongs su gyur pa las thugs rdo rje nas bkrus/ khyed rnams kyi snying gar sgra gcan gyi dkyil 'khor la thugs rdo rje rnams 'jug par gsol ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dpal ldan thugs kyi rdo rje nas khyed rnams kyi yid thugs rdo rjer gyur par mos/ de ltar byas pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i bdag nyid du gyur pa nga'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes dang nga rgyal gzung ngo*// de dag gi don bshad pa ni tshangs pa sku'i rdo rje 'dzin nas/ de yang khyab 'jug rdzu 'phrul che// rdo rje slob dpon zhes dang*/ de bzhin du mtshan yang dag par brjod pa las/ gtsug phud phud bu lcang lo can// ral pa muñdza cod paṇa thogs// gdong lnga zur phud lnga dang ldan// zur phud lnga pa me tog thod// ces pa ste de'i don ni/ de ltar dbang bskur bas bshang ba dang byang chub kyi sems dang dri chu rnams kyi khams 'dzag med sgrib bral du gyur pas tshangs pa dang dbang phyug chen po dang khyab 'jug ste/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon chen por gyur to zhes pa'i tha tshig go

/de ltar dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du zhes sogs nas sgrub pa por gyur pa yin no// gsum pa rjes slob dpon gyi dam tshig bstan pa la/ dam tshig bstan dang gsol ba gdab// dbugs dbyung slob la spro tshig brjod// ces pa ltar las/ dam tshig bstan pa ni/ 'dir ston pa po'i dbang la mngon par dbang bskur ba'i dge slong ngam zhes sogs nas rnam par bshig pa'i phyir ro// zhes pa'i bar brjod de/ des na de lta bu'i dam tshig rnams ma bsrungs na nyes dmigs shin tu che bas bsrung dgos so zhes bstan pa yin no// dkyil 'khor pa la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ khyed rnams kyi steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can re bzung*/ phyag thal mo sbyar nas dkyil 'khor la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas par bsam zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ oṃ ma hā ra ta nas māṃ/ zhes brjod kyin bskor ba byas te shar sgor slebs/ gdugs logs su bzhag ste gnas pa na/ slob dpon gyis/ rgyud rnams 'dzin par 'gyur ba yi// slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags// zhes pas khyed rnams dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phul zhing gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pas mgrin gcig tu dbugs dbyung ba ni/ da ni khyod nyid dkyil 'khor gyis// zhes sogs nas dgongs shing byin gyis rlobs par 'gyur ro zhes dbugs dbyung ba na/ de la khyed rnams shin tu dga' zhing spro ba'i tshig gis ched du brjod pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng bdag skye ba nas sras su deng bdag 'gyur// zhes brjod pa dang bcas pa ni rdo rje slob dpon bdag po'i dbang ste de rnams kyis dbang bskur ba 'khor dang bcas pa legs par thob nas gnas skabs de dag tu thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs rnams bsrung bsdam bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar zhes sogs brjod pas dam tshig 'dzin par khas blangs nas/

dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal phul la/ gzhan yang lus longs spyod dge ba'i dngos po thams cad kyang ltos pa med par 'bul/ cha shas nas bdag gir mdzad de/ longs spyad du gsol snyam pas deng nas sogs kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de nas snying rje'i dbang bskur sbyin pa'i don du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad bkug ste dkyil 'khor 'dir bcug ste dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi nas 'thor zhing*/ oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta a bhi ṣe ke ṇa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ zhes nang gi bdud rtsi lngas dbang bskur bas/ rdo rje can gyi lam thob ste dri ma dang bral nas byang chub kyi spyod pa la gnas pas slar yang rang gi gnas su song bar gyur zhes brjod do// de rnams kyis ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nas kho bo cag gi 'dren pa mtshungs med dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang gnyis su ma mchis pa'i bar mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las legs par 'ongs pa'i dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por byis pa 'jug pa'i dbang bdun gyis mngon par dbang bskur nas ma 'ongs par de bzhin gshegs pa rnams su 'gyur bar lung bstan cing rjes su gnang ba dang*/ zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor mchog gi nges don gyi dkyil 'khor rnams su dbang gong ma bzhi gong chen dang bcas pa 'dren mchog chos kyi rgyal po bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa gong gi zhal snga nas ji ltar mnos pa'i phyag len ltar 'bul ba'i tshul bgyis pa yin pas rang dang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa zhu/ zhes dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid ces sogs brjod cing*/ dge ba bla na med pa'i byang chub chen por bsngos nas/ slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i rjes kyi rim pa rnams byas nas/

bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di dag ni blo mchog 'bring thun mong bar med du mi rung ba'i bshad pa bya ba'i tshul yin la/ skabs 'gar 'di las spros pa la mos pas ni/ gong gi rgyud sde'i ngos bzung gi dus su rgyud kyi byung tshul dang brgyud pa'i rtogs pa brjod pa rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa gzhan du 'byung ba ltar bshad kyang shin tu legs par 'gyur te/ rnam bshad rigs pa las/ zhum la gzengs bstod rgod pa la// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs legs par bstan// rmugs pa rnams la ngo mtshar gyi// gtam bshad nas ni nyan du gzhug /ces gsungs pa'i phyir ro// 'dir smras pa/ dpe rgyan las the tshom/ lha mchog ngag gi dbang phyug smra sgo las// zab yangs chos kun snyan dngags glur 'jo'am// kun dga'i legs bshad 'byung gnas bla ma de// gsang chen chos 'khor bskor snyam 'phyang mo nyug / gsal byed las bya ba thog ma/ gsal bar byas so kun mkhyen mkhas pa'i gzhung*// thun mong blo yis rnam par dpyad dka'i gnas// gzhung don mthun par 'chad tshul mi bde ba// thos nyung slob mas mnyan par dka' ba yang*// gzugs can las 'gal ba/ dug can bsti gnas bsrubs las byung ba min// sbyin ma'i bu yi bcud skal ma phrogs par// dbang bskur bshad pa'i 'chi med zil dngar 'dis// gsang rgyud bstan pa ring 'tsho'i bcud len byed// bskor ba las tshig don gnyis ka mkhas tshul gsum gyis lugs 'di snang byed pa// dngos brgyud bla ma'i sku drin gsob phyir bris// bla ma'i spyod rjes sgrub pa'i phrin las rgyun// mi nub bskal pa'i srid du brling phyir bris// 'gog pa las 'byung bar 'gyur ba/ e ma dri med bstan pa gnas dus 'dir// de rgyun ring 'tsho'i cho ga rgyang bskyungs na// slad mar ming tsam thos pa'i lam song tshe// 'gyod pas rjes su snyeg gam blo chen rnams//

bsdus brjod las khyad gzhi tha dad cing khyad chos mtshungs pa/ bag med gnas pa bag yod bskul byed cing*// bdag med chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'bum ldir ba// skal bzang 'chi ba med pa'i rnga bo che// bskrun pa'i byed por gyur bdag skal ba sbom// shis par brjod pa/ dge bas thos na sangs rgyas sa bon 'jog /bsams na legs pa'i blo gros ci yang 'phel// bsgoms na mi ring mchog gi dngos grub ster// gsang sngags bstan pa'i bshad sgrub rgyas gyur cig /ces dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur ba'i bshad pa 'chi ba med pa'i rnga sgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dbang phyug bla ma kun dga' rgya mtsho pa dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod sogs kyi rdo rje slob dpon chen po kun dga' phun tshogs pa zung gi bka' mchid tam+bu ra'i dbyangs kyi spun zlas bskul bar brten/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs dkyil 'khor cho ga yan lag bcas dang*/ mkhyen rab rjes mdzad pa'i lhan thabs la sogs pa lugs srol 'di'i lag len phra mo tshun chad thugs ka'i dpal gyi be'ur legs par chud cing*/ dbang lung sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs la sogs pa'i sku drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' dang mi gnyis pa'i 'dren mchog ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pas rjes 'jug blo 'dzin pa rnams la phan pa'i ched du yig cha de dag phyogs gcig tu bklag chog tu bstar bar mdzad pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs dngos grub 'dod 'jo dang dkyil 'khor cho ga spangs rtogs kyi yon tan kun nas 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i skabs kyi bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga nyid gzhir bzung*/ der med pa'i dbang gong ma rnams bu ston gyis mdzad pa rnams dang bcas pa'i tshig don rnams la cung zad 'dris par bltas shing go dka' ba'i gnas rnams rgyud 'grel dag la'ang nye bar gtugs te kha 'gengs 'os pa cung zad res rnam par brgyan cing*/

thun mong ltar bshad du btub pa rnams spyi 'gros su btang ba dang bcas te/ gong ma'i yig cha de dag gi zhabs 'degs kyi tshul du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i tshul gyis btags ming du ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bod pas/ rab byung 'dod pa'i 'dzin byed kyi gnam lo shar ba/ dus 'khor ba'i dgun 'bring po/ rags par smal pos nya zhing zhib par lag hor lugs kyi zla ba bcu gcig pa/ rgya rtsis kyi dpyid rwa ba lcags stag dmar phyogs kyi dga' ba dang po/ dbyangs lā/ gsal byed ṭhaklā/ 'byung ba sa/ 'dod yon dri/ dar gud byis pa/ nyi ma chu sbrul/ spar kha zon/ sme ba bdun dmar/ res gza' lha'i bla ma/ rags par gud pa/ zhib par dar ba/ skar ma rgyal stod dang lhan cig 'dzom pa'i bdud las rgyal ba/ sbyor chung phun tshogs sbyor ba/ 'phrod chen grub pa/ sbyor ba dge ba/ rten 'brel skye ba/ byed pa byis pa can rnams tshogs pa'i nyin sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang po'i phyogs kyi ba gam gsum par grub par bgyis pa dge legs rab tu 'phel par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
